You are working on TriageX (repository root, macOS). Read docs/TriageX_Developer_Handoff.md
Sections 4.3, 6, 13, and docs/chert-status.md. Real caller frames must be VERIFIED there; if not, stop.

PROJECT CONTEXT
- agent/ is the Chert/LiveKit Node agent from the official starter; it already logs real frames.
- The backend (FastAPI, backend/) is the only authority for staffing and simulation state.
- Fictional demo staff already exist in backend/app/services/demo_service.py (DEMO_STAFF:
  rn-avery, rn-jordan, rn-morgan, rn-riley, rn-casey, rn-quinn). The card spec is in Section 13 of the
  handoff and docs/handoff/staff-card.svg.

PREREQUISITES
- Prompt 2 accepted: docs/chert-status.md says "Our agent receives real caller frames: VERIFIED".
- Printed test cards (Section 13), a vision-capable model ID confirmed in the provider's docs.
If frames are not VERIFIED, stop immediately and report the blocker.

RULES
- Synthetic data only; cards say "TriageX DEMO" and "FICTIONAL". No raw frames stored.
- Do not fake recognition. Use a vision-capable model whose ID you confirm in the official provider
  docs (VISION_MODEL in agent/.env.local). Secrets only in .env / agent/.env.local.
- The agent extracts fields; it never decides whether a card is valid (the backend does, Prompt 4).

OBJECTIVE: the agent reliably extracts card fields from live FaceTime video.

REQUIREMENTS
1. Synthetic roster: create backend/app/data/staff_roster.json mapping card IDs to DEMO_STAFF, e.g.
   TX-RN-1001 -> rn-avery (Registered Nurse, available), TX-RN-1002 -> rn-jordan, TX-RN-1003 ->
   rn-morgan, plus at least one entry that is OFF DUTY. TX-RN-9999 must NOT be on the roster.
2. Printable cards: generate docs/handoff/cards.html (or PDF) with 3 valid cards (1001–1003) and 2
   invalid ones (9999 unknown ID; an OFF DUTY card), large high-contrast text per Section 13.
3. In agent/: sample at most one frame per second from facetime-remote-video while in "awaiting card"
   state; downscale; send to the vision model with a strict JSON schema:
   {card_present: bool, header_says_triagex_demo: bool, card_id: string|null, name: string|null,
    role: string|null, availability: string|null, shift: string|null, confidence: 0..1}.
   Accept a reading only when the same card_id is extracted in 2 consecutive samples with
   confidence >= 0.8; otherwise ask the caller (by voice) to hold the card closer / steadier.
   Time out after 45 seconds and say the card could not be read.
4. Handle: no card, camera off/muted, track replaced, FaceTime UI in frame, glare.
5. Unit-test the parsing/stability logic in the agent with recorded JSON outputs (not images).
6. Live test with the printed cards: valid 1001 read correctly; 9999 read as 9999 (rejection
   happens in Prompt 4); a blank page yields card_present=false. Record results (fields only) in
   docs/chert-status.md.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- In a real FaceTime call, the agent extracts the correct card_id for 3 different cards, and reports
  card_present=false for a non-card. No images written to disk. Agent tests pass.

GIT: after my approval, commit "feat(agent): live staff-card recognition from FaceTime video"; push;
check Entire. STOP before connecting the agent to backend confirmation endpoints.

ADDENDUM (changes since the handoff was written; these override the handoff where they differ):
- Node 24 is required (~/.zshrc puts /opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin first). Homebrew's Node 25 is broken.
- The agent uses Gemini, not OpenAI: voice is Gemini Live via @livekit/agents-plugin-google 1.8.0,
  key GOOGLE_API_KEY in agent/.env.local (Gemini API free tier, no billing). Use a Gemini Flash
  model for vision on the same key; list the models available to the key (GET
  https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models with header x-goog-api-key, never print
  the key) and confirm the chosen ID in Google's docs. Do not add OpenAI or any paid provider.
- Reuse the frame handling in agent/frame-probe.mjs (VideoStream, staleness, mute/track-replacement).
  Caller video is 1280x720 I420 at ~15 fps; crop to the centre before sending.
- @livekit/agents-plugin-google 1.8.0 does NOT forward video into Gemini Live (pushVideo is a no-op),
  so card reading must be a separate vision call, not the voice session.
- For development I will test with the cards shown on my monitor; the demo will use printed cards.
  cards.html should let me click a card to show it full-screen.
- Start/stop: agent `npm start` (terminal 1); from agent/:
  npx --yes @trychert/facetime@0.1.0-beta.21 dev --agent triagex-facetime-agent --minutes 30
  (terminal 2). Stop chert dev with Ctrl+C/SIGINT and wait for dev_stopped. Keep test calls short;
  the trial has ~47 FaceTime minutes left.
- Never ask me to paste keys into chat; I edit .env.local myself.

# Chert FaceTime status

Last updated: 2026-11-14 (macOS, Node 24.22.3, `@trychert/facetime@0.1.0-beta.21`).
No secrets and no phone numbers are recorded here. Times are US Eastern (UTC−5).

> The **hosted Chert demo agent** was not used for any result below. Every call in this file was
> answered by **our own agent** (`agent/`, `triagex-facetime-agent`) through `chert dev`.

## Status

| Item | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Chert authentication | **VERIFIED** | `chert whoami`: signed in, role **owner**, project `36c65de7-…-4398`, `confirmed: true` |
| Line provisioned | **VERIFIED** | `chert doctor`: line "Silas Thorne" available, routing configured, calls enabled, worker Mac checked in |

| Trial | **ACTIVE** | `chert doctor`: 47 of 50 FaceTime minutes left after two test calls; "trial line stays yours until your trial ends" |
| LiveKit Cloud (own project) | **VERIFIED** | `chert doctor`: "LiveKit accepted the credentials"; `doctor --agent`: agent joined a test room in 1.2 s. Chert-managed LiveKit: `livekit_not_provisioned` |
| Voice model | **VERIFIED** | Gemini Live `gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025`, Gemini API free tier, via `@livekit/agents-plugin-google` 1.8.0 (replaces the starter's paid OpenAI realtime model) |
| Two-way voice with our agent | **VERIFIED** (logs) | Call 1, below. Subjective audio quality not yet reported by the caller |
| Caller camera capture (`facetime-remote-video`) | **VERIFIED** | Call 2, below. Enabled on this line without a request to Chert |
| Our agent receives real caller frames | **VERIFIED** | Call 2: 609 frames, luminance follows the camera |
| Outbound FaceTime (agent places the call) | **UNKNOWN** | Not tested; needs a project API key and `POST /api/v1/calls` (handoff Section 6.4, Phase D2) |
| Project API key / `CHERT_LINE_ID` in `.env` | **PENDING** | Not needed for inbound calls via `chert dev`; needed for outbound calls and the shared-line iMessage adapter (Prompt 5) |

## Call 1: two-way voice (11:08:59–11:10:21, about 80 s)

`chert dev` records: `call_incoming` (FaceTime Video) → `call_accepted` in 0.1 s (warm) →
`call_bridge_ready` after 6.6 s → `call_media`: "Video and audio are coming from" our agent
participant (`video: true`) → `call_ended`.

Agent log: greeting started in the same second as `bridge_ready` (Chert requires < 10 s); Gemini's
server-side voice activity detection registered 5 caller turns and a spoken reply was generated for
each; no errors; the session closed on caller hang-up (`CLIENT_INITIATED`).

## Call 2: caller frames (11:21:16–11:22:11, about 55 s)

Frame probe (`agent/frame-probe.mjs`) excerpt. Numbers only; no image was stored.

```text
11:21:18 participant_connected  chert-bridge-0d536eaa-…
11:21:23 track_published         facetime-remote-video  KIND_VIDEO SOURCE_CAMERA video/VP8 1280x720
11:21:23 track_published         facetime-remote-audio  KIND_AUDIO SOURCE_MICROPHONE audio/opus
11:21:25 room_snapshot (bridge_ready): both tracks present, unmuted
11:21:26 frame 1280x720 I420 ts=109306574000us luma=58.2 fps=14.9 total=49     (normal view)
11:21:32 frame 1280x720 I420 ts=109312692000us luma=75.1 fps=14.5 total=139    (bright)
11:21:45 frame 1280x720 I420 ts=109324865000us luma=14.2 fps=14.8 total=319    (lens covered)
11:21:47 frame 1280x720 I420 ts=109326883000us luma=12.2 fps=14.9 total=349    (lens covered)
11:21:53 frame 1280x720 I420 ts=109332980000us luma=49.9 fps=14.9 total=439    (printed page)
11:22:04 track_muted facetime-remote-video                                       (hang-up)
11:22:06 no_current_frame muted=true ms_since_last_frame=2123                    (no stale frame reused)
11:22:06 video_stream_closed total_frames=609; tracks unpublished; participant_disconnected
```

Findings:
- The bridge publishes `facetime-remote-video` (1280×720, about 15 fps) and `facetime-remote-audio`.
- Frame timestamps advance about 1.01 s per sample, so frames are live, not repeated.
- Luminance tracks the camera: about 50–60 normal, about 12–20 with the lens covered. The caller
  reports the lens was only partly covered, which explains why it did not reach 0. Chert's docs
  warn that frames may include FaceTime UI or self-preview, so card recognition should still crop
  to the centre and require two consistent reads.
- On hang-up the track is muted, and the probe reports `no_current_frame` rather than an old frame.

## Next

Prompt 3: live staff-card recognition from these frames (one frame per second while awaiting a
card), using a vision model on the Gemini API free tier.

Exit code 1
### 4.3 How a staffing confirmation propagates

This path is shared by every channel; new channels (FaceTime, the hackathon iMessage API) must reuse it
rather than modify the simulation.

1. **Approval.** `POST /api/runs/{run_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/approve` with `at_tick` (the
   playhead) calls `DemoService.approve_proposal()`, which creates a `StaffingRequest` with
   `approved_tick`, a 10-minute wall-clock `expires_at`, and bumps `run.version`. `start_outreach()`
   in `api/chert.py` queues live messages in the background only if Chert is configured.
2. **Reply.** A channel produces a reply:
   - simulated: `simulate-reply` → `DemoService.simulate_reply()`;
   - Chert console webhook: `POST /api/webhooks/chert` → `OutreachService.handle_webhook()` (verify
     signature → parse → deduplicate on `event_id` → correlate to a message we sent → accept only
     `IN`) → `DemoService.confirm_live()`;
   - **planned FaceTime:** agent → FastAPI → `DemoService.confirm_live()` with a new `facetime` source.
3. **Validation and recompute.** `DemoService._record_reply()` rejects anything that is not `IN`, an
   expired request, a full request, or a duplicate staff identity. It then appends a
   `ConfirmationRecord` and calls `Run.recompute()`, which re-simulates **only** the TriageX track with
   `StaffingIntervention(approved_tick, confirmed_staff)`, effective at `approved_tick + 3`.
4. **Publish.** `build_dashboard()` builds the new `DashboardState`; `PersistenceWriter.submit()`
   queues a snapshot for Tiger Data; `ConnectionManager.broadcast()` sends
   `{"type": "run.updated", "run_id", "version", "reason"}`.
5. **Dashboard.** `useDemo.ts` receives `run.updated`, refetches `GET /api/runs/{run_id}` if the
   version is newer, and adopts it. `lib/demo.ts` reveals data only up to the playhead, so nothing
   changes on screen before 17:15 even though the recomputed future is already loaded.

// Greet the caller once, when FaceTime is ready.
//
// When the Chert Mac reports bridge_ready for the call, chert dev sets the room's metadata to
// {"chert_call":"<call id>","chert_bridge_ready":true,"at":"<ISO time>"}. The Mac ends a call whose agent sends
// no audible audio within 10 seconds of bridge_ready (remote_audio_timeout), so the agent greets then.
// Participant arrival is not enough: FaceTime may still be connecting. Without the signal there is no
// greeting, and the caller speaks first.

// RoomEvent.RoomMetadataChanged in @livekit/rtc-node. The room's metadata is already updated when it fires.
const METADATA_CHANGED = 'roomMetadataChanged';

/**
 * True when the room metadata carries chert dev's bridge_ready signal.
 * @param {string | undefined} metadata
 */
export function bridgeReady(metadata) {
  try { return JSON.parse(metadata || '{}')?.chert_bridge_ready === true; } catch { return false; }
}

/**
 * Calls greet() once: at once if the signal is already in the room, otherwise when it arrives.
 * Returns a function that stops waiting.
 * @param {{ metadata?: string, on(event: string, listener: () => void): unknown, off(event: string, listener: () => void): unknown }} room
 * @param {() => unknown} greet
 * @returns {() => void}
 */
export function greetOnBridgeReady(room, greet) {
  let done = false;
  const stop = () => { done = true; room.off(METADATA_CHANGED, check); };
  function check() {
    if (done || !bridgeReady(room.metadata)) return;
    stop();
    try { greet(); } catch { /* the call ended first */ }

  room.on(METADATA_CHANGED, check);
  check();
  return stop;

### 6.1 Official requirements (from `https://www.trychert.com/emory`, read 2026-11-14)

- **Prize:** Best Use of FaceTime (Chert). The 1st-place prize is $400 and guaranteed interviews for
  Chert's FDE and SWE internships.
- **Qualifying:** build on Chert's FaceTime API (iMessage is optional but encouraged); bring at least
  one iPhone; **the agent must make or take a FaceTime call during the demo**.
- **Judging:** live, in person, by Chert. Show it working on a **real** FaceTime call.
- **Criteria:**
  - **fresh use of FaceTime video, weighted 2×** ("it uses what it sees in a way we haven't seen");
  - wow factor, 1×;
  - usefulness, 1×.
- **Submission:** on Devpost, select **"Best Use of FaceTime (Chert)"**.
- **Free line:** about 5 minutes of setup via `https://app.trychert.com/skills.md`. Trial: 50 FaceTime
  minutes, calls up to 5 minutes, valid 24 hours from activation (**48 hours for trials started by
  18 November 2026**). A Shared line handles **one call at a time**.
- **Support:** Chert Discord, or the Chert help desk at the event.

### 6.2 The signature interaction

**Hospital surge → FaceTime call → live camera verification → explicit staff confirmation → simulation
update → the two futures diverge.**

The video is the verification step, not decoration. That is what scores the 2× criterion: the agent
reads a fictional staff card from the live camera, checks it against a synthetic roster, rejects
unreadable or invalid cards, and only then asks for verbal confirmation.

### 6.3 What Chert's documentation confirms (read 2026-11-14)

| Capability | What the docs say | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Inbound FaceTime calls | Supported. Use `chert dev` (no webhook needed) or an incoming-decision webhook, which must answer within 5 s. | `facetime/bring-your-own-room`, `facetime/capabilities` |

Video needs a line that is enabled and ready for outbound video. `201` means the call was allocated, **not** answered. | `facetime/outbound`, `facetime/calls-api`, `skills.md` |

Frames may include FaceTime controls, names or self-preview. The agent supplies the vision model. | `facetime/audio-video`, `facetime/capabilities`, `facetime-cli/video` |

Annotations must be rendered into the agent's own published video. Chert-hosted video composition is **unsupported**. | `facetime-cli/video`, `facetime/capabilities` |
| Runtime | Starter `agent.mjs` (Node 22.23.2+ or 24.x) with `@livekit/agents` and `@livekit/agents-plugin-openai` 1.8.0 and the OpenAI realtime voice model. Your own LiveKit Cloud project by default. | `facetime-cli/build-agent`, `skills.md` |
| Reachable phones | A Shared line can reach only phones **verified for the project**, by iMessaging a 6-digit code from that phone. SMS, group chats and email do not count. | `skills.md` |

`chert dev` supports outbound calls; the exact API host for calls (`skills.md` lists

`https://facetime.trychert.com/api/v1/calls`); and how extra team phones are added after onboarding.

agent's own published track, and that annotations must be rendered into it. So rendering a simple
"surge briefing" card into the agent's video is consistent with the docs, but it is **unverified**.
Treat it as optional, after the core flow works.

### 6.4 Recommended demonstration architecture

- **Phase D1 (fewest unknowns): the agent takes the call.** After the operator approves, the teammate
  receives the outreach alert and FaceTimes the TriageX line. The agent is connected with `chert dev`,

- **Speed problem found and fixed:** with temperature 0, requests sometimes took 20–60 s or hung. With the default temperature they took about 1–2 s.
  - Free-tier latency still jumps around (I saw 13–57 s spells), so the agent keeps up to 4 requests in flight.
  - Results are applied in the order the frames were taken, and an older frame can never complete a reading.
- **Tests:** `npm test` gives 33/33 passing. They use real model outputs saved as JSON (text only, no images).
- **Offline check:** I rendered fake 1280×720 camera scenes of the cards and sent them through the same path as live video.
  - All five cards gave the correct ID, including a mirrored one; the mirrored card misread one word in the shift line.
  - The blank page gave `card_present=false`.
  - Glare over the ID gave no ID and confidence 0, so the model didn't guess.

I haven't touched `.env.local`. The model defaults to `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`; you can add `VISION_MODEL=gemini-3.5-flash-lite` there if you want it explicit.

The live test passed the acceptance criteria. In a real FaceTime Video call, the agent read the correct ID for 5 different cards, and the blank screen gave `card_present=false`. I haven't committed anything; that waits for your approval.

| Shown | Read as | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| TX-RN-1001 | **TX-RN-1001** | 1.0 / 1.0 |
| TX-RN-1002 | **TX-RN-1002** | 0.99 / 0.99 |
| TX-RN-1003 | **TX-RN-1003** | 1.0 / 0.99 |
| TX-RN-9999 | **TX-RN-9999** (rejecting it is Prompt 4's job) | 0.99 / 0.99 |
| TX-RN-1004 | **TX-RN-1004**, OFF DUTY | 1.0 / 1.0 |
| Blank screen | `card_present=false` on every sample; it asked for the card twice, then timed out at 45 s | 0 |

- **Wrong IDs:** all 34 applied results had the correct ID, or none when no card was in view. 24 more results arrived after a newer one and were dropped without being logged. I can't vouch for those, so they now get logged too.
- **Other fields:** the name and shift lines were sometimes misread from the monitor (e.g. 1001's name came back as "Fictional RN"). Prompt 4 should match on `card_id` only and take name, role and shift from the roster.
- **Storage:** no images were written anywhere. Logs hold text fields only.
- **Not tested live:** covering the lens, turning the camera off, and printed cards.

**Fixed after the call** (38/38 agent tests and 167 backend tests pass, but not yet tried on a call):
1. **Rate limit:** the free tier allows 15 requests per minute per model. My 1-per-second sampling went over it five times, and each time Gemini paused us for up to about 56 s. Requests are now spread out to stay under the limit, and an unchanged empty view isn't re-sent for 8 s. That keeps requests in hand for when a card appears.
2. **Restarted scans:** Gemini Live called `scan_staff_card` on its own five times, restarting scans that were already running. A running scan is now left alone.
3. **Stray character:** a control character appeared inside one role string; those are now removed.

The results are recorded as "Call 3" in [docs/chert-status.md](docs/chert-status.md). `chert dev` was stopped with SIGINT and released the line (`dev_stopped`), the agent is stopped, and 42 trial minutes are left.

# TriageX — 90-Second Live Demo Script

**One surge. Two futures. One confirmed response that changes the outcome.**

Every number on screen comes from the TriageX API (I-85 Multi-Vehicle Pileup, seed 42).
The presenter only moves the playhead and clicks the two explicit actions.

## Before going on stage

1. Start the backend:
   ```powershell
   cd backend
   uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
   ```
2. Start the frontend:
   ```powershell
   cd frontend
   npm run dev
   ```
   Then open http://localhost:5173.
3. Press **F** for fullscreen.
4. Click **Reset** (or press **Shift+R**). The clock reads **15:00**, the hero reads
   **0.00 h**, and the Next Event button reads **Start Surge**.
5. Optional: run `npm run rehearse -- rehearsal 1366 768` in `frontend/`. It walks the
   whole demo in Edge, checks the layout fits, and saves screenshots.

**Controls:**
- **Next Event:** the big teal button, **→**, or **Page Down**, which works with most
  presentation clickers.
- **Play/pause:** Space.
- **Step back one tick:** ←.
- **Technical view for judges:** D.

## The walkthrough

| Time | Presenter does | Screen shows | Say |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–10 s | — | Calm network, two identical futures | "Five Atlanta EDs. Every capacity tool shows you *this*." |
| 10–20 s | **Next → Start Surge** | Clock runs to 16:00, Surge marker, Grady turns amber | "16:00, a pileup on I-85. Ambulances head for Grady." |
| 20–30 s | **Next → Show Prediction** | 16:15: Surge Predicted, dotted 2-hour forecast, card **Call in 3 staff at Grady** | "TriageX forecasts Grady over capacity within two hours, and proposes calling in staff." |
| 30–40 s | **Next** (moves to 16:30), then click **Approve outreach** | Outreach Approved 16:30 · 0/3 · shift starts 17:15; the 45-minute lead-time band appears | "A human approves. Nothing is automatic." |
| 40–55 s | Click **Simulate staff reply "IN"** three times | 1/3 → 2/3 → 3/3, Staff Confirmed in the feed, "Grady staffed capacity 45 → 56 from 17:15"; **the hero stays at 0.00** | "Staff confirm, but nothing changes yet: they need 45 minutes to arrive." |
| 55–65 s | **Next → Activate Shift** | 17:15: **SHIFT ACTIVE — GRADY**, Futures Diverge in the feed | "17:15, the shift starts. Same emergency, same patients, a different response." |
| 65–85 s | **Next → Reveal Impact** | The single line splits into two, the gap shades teal, the hero counts up to **9.25 h**, Back to Normal at 20:00 vs 20:45 | "Without TriageX, 25.5 ambulance-hours lost to handoff delays. With it, 16.25: 36% fewer. Grady recovers 45 minutes sooner." |
| 85–90 s | — | Final result | "Every ER capacity tool shows you the problem. TriageX calls the people who can fix it." |

Measured machine time for all six steps: about 14 seconds. The rest is narration.

## Things to say only if asked

- **The numbers:** they are synthetic, computed by a deterministic simulation. The final
  figures are only revealed when the playhead reaches them.
- **The replies:** they are a labeled simulated fallback. A real iMessage reply will
  update the same panel once the Chert integration (Phase 6) is verified.
- **Tiger Data:** press **D** for the persistence panel. It shows stored rows for this
  run and an hourly `time_bucket` query over the TimescaleDB hypertable.

## If something goes wrong

| Problem | What to do |
|---|---|
| Live reply does not arrive (Phase 6) | Click **Simulate staff reply "IN"**; the flow continues without a restart. |
| Backend error banner | Check the backend window, then click **Reset**. |
| Clicked past a step | Scrub the timeline back or press ←. Approval and confirmations stay recorded until Reset. |
| Pressed Next before approving | Nothing is approved automatically; the hint asks you to click **Approve outreach**. |
-----
### 3.1 The verified I-85 seed-42 demonstration

Values below are taken from `frontend/src/test/fixtures/confirmed3.json`, an export of real API
responses (`scripts/export_fixtures.py`), and are asserted by the test suites.

| Simulated time | Tick | Event |
|---|---|---|
| 15:00 | 12 | Demo window opens; both futures identical |
| 16:00 | 16 | Surge begins (pileup on I-85) |
| 16:15 | 17 | Surge predicted; outreach proposed: call in 3 staff at Grady |
| 16:30 | 18 | Human approves outreach; confirmations are recorded at this simulated time |
| 17:15 | 21 | Confirmed staff become active (16:30 + 45 min); **the two futures diverge** |
| 20:00 / 20:45 | | Grady back to normal with / without TriageX (45 minutes sooner) |
| 21:00 | 36 | Demo window closes |

With **3 of 3** staff confirmed, the demo-window outcome is: **25.50 → 16.25 ambulance-hours lost to
handoff delay (−9.25 h, −36.3%)**, mean wait 6.8 minutes shorter (−48%), and 3 fewer ambulance
diversions (−30%).

> These figures hold only for **three** confirmations approved at 16:30. With fewer confirmations, or
> a different approval tick, the outcome is different. Always read the result from the API; never
> quote 9.25 for a different run.

---

### 1.1 Final scope decisions (agreed by the team, 2026-11-14)

The core product does not change. TriageX remains an AI-powered emergency-department surge response
system: it predicts overcrowding, recommends interventions, obtains human approval, coordinates
staffing, and demonstrates the impact through a deterministic simulation.

1. **Keep unchanged:** the simulation, Tiger Data integration, FastAPI backend, dashboard, and the
   baseline-versus-TriageX comparison.
2. **Chert FaceTime extends the existing staff outreach and confirmation workflow.** It is not a
   separate product.
3. **The FaceTime agent:**
   - uses genuine live video to read a fictional staff availability card;
   - checks it against a synthetic roster;
   - obtains explicit verbal confirmation;
   - triggers the existing staffing confirmation service.
4. **iMessage stays** as a practical staffing channel and as the fallback.
5. **Patient navigation** was a secondary, text-based feature in the original brief and was
   deliberately cut from the MVP. It is documented as future work (Section 16).
6. **Patient-facing FaceTime and visual injury assessment** are new, unimplemented proposals. Do not
   build them during the hackathon, and do not present them as original requirements.
7. **The simulation's underlying logic must not be modified** to accommodate FaceTime.

The two halves aren't connected yet. The FaceTime card reader works, but linking it to the backend and dashboard is Prompt 4. So today's honest full demo runs both halves side by side, and the staff replies on the dashboard must stay labelled as simulated. The steps below show where Prompt 4 will join them.

## End-to-end demo steps (what works today)

**Setup (about 10 min before; four terminals plus the iPhone):**
1. Plug in the Mac and run `caffeinate -dimsu` so it doesn't sleep.
2. **Terminal 1, backend:**
   ```
   cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
   ```
3. **Terminal 2, dashboard:**
   ```
   cd frontend && npm run dev
   ```
   Open http://localhost:5173, press **F** for fullscreen, then **Shift+R** to reset. Expect 15:00 and a hero number of 0.00 h.
4. **Terminal 3, agent:**
   ```
   cd agent && CARD_AUTO_RESCAN=1 npm start
   ```
   `CARD_AUTO_RESCAN=1` makes it re-arm after each card read, so you can show several cards.
5. **Terminal 4, FaceTime line:**
   ```
   cd agent && npx --yes @trychert/facetime@0.1.0-beta.21 dev --agent triagex-facetime-agent --minutes 30
   ```
   Wait until it says the agent is in a waiting room.
6. Have the printed cards (or `docs/handoff/cards.html`) and the iPhone ready, with Do Not Disturb off.

**The demo (about 2 min):**
1. **Calm state:** five Atlanta EDs, and both futures look the same. "Every capacity tool shows you this."
2. **Next, Start Surge:** a pileup on I-85 at 16:00, and Grady turns amber.
3. **Next, Show Prediction:** TriageX predicts Grady will be over capacity within 2 hours and proposes "Call in 3 staff at Grady."
4. **Next to 16:30, then click Approve outreach:** a human approves; nothing happens automatically. The counter shows 0/3, and a 45-minute arrival band appears.
5. **The teammate FaceTime-videos the line.** The agent greets them and asks for their staff card.
6. **Show TX-RN-9999:** the agent reads the ID back from the live video. Rejecting it as "not on the roster" needs Prompt 4; today the agent only says it isn't verified yet.
7. **Show TX-RN-1001:** the agent reads "T X, R N, 1 0 0 1, Avery, available."
8. **Hang up. On the dashboard, click Simulate staff reply "IN" three times** and say they are simulated: "the FaceTime-to-dashboard link is the next step." The counter goes to 3/3, and the hero number stays at 0.00.
9. **Next, Activate Shift:** at 17:15 the confirmed staff arrive.
10. **Next, Reveal Impact:** the two futures split, and the hero number counts up to **9.25 h** of ambulance time saved (−36%). Grady recovers 45 minutes sooner. Quote the number on screen; 9.25 h only applies with 3 confirmations approved at 16:30.
11. Optional: press **D** for the technical view, which shows the data stored in Tiger Data.
12. **Shut down:** Ctrl+C in Terminal 4, wait for `dev_stopped`, then stop the others.

**After Prompt 4,** steps 6–8 become the real thing:
- 9999 is rejected by voice and the counter doesn't move.
- 1001 is checked against the roster, and the caller says "I confirm."
- The counter goes to 1/3, labelled **Live FaceTime**.

Each call uses trial minutes, and 42 are left, so rehearse with short calls.

## What TriageX can do

**Working and tested:**
- **Simulates an ED surge** across five Atlanta emergency departments: the I-85 pileup, the same run every time (seed 42).
- **Predicts overcrowding** about two hours ahead and **recommends an action** (call in 3 staff at Grady).
- **Requires human approval** before any outreach; approvals expire after 10 minutes.
- **Records staff confirmations** and re-runs only the TriageX future. Staff take effect after a realistic 45-minute arrival time.
- **Shows two futures side by side**, without and with TriageX: 25.5 h vs 16.25 h of ambulance time lost to handoff delays, waits 48% shorter, 3 fewer diversions.
- **Live dashboard:** a playhead, presenter-friendly keyboard and clicker controls, real-time updates, and a technical view for judges.
- **Stores runs in Tiger Data** (TimescaleDB time-series tables).
- **Answers real FaceTime video calls** through Chert, with a Gemini Live voice agent and an animated face.
- **Reads a fictional staff card from the caller's live video:**
  - fields: card ID, name, role, availability (AVAILABLE / OFF DUTY) and shift;
  - accepts a card only after two matching readings;
  - coaches the caller by voice (closer, steadier, glare, camera off) and gives up after 45 s;
  - no frames are stored;
  - proven on a real call: 5 cards read correctly, and a blank screen gave "no card."

**Built, not yet proven live:**
- Sending iMessage outreach through Chert's console API.

**Not built yet:**
- FaceTime → roster check → spoken "I confirm" → dashboard update (Prompt 4).
- iMessage on the hackathon line (Prompt 5).
- An AI-written operational brief (Prompt 6).
- The agent placing the FaceTime call itself (outbound).

I can turn this into a shareable one-page demo runbook if your teammates need it.
Build all of it now
That's three separate prompts in the handoff (4, 5 and 6), plus outbound calling. I'll read their specs first so I build to them and know which steps need you: keys, live calls, approvals.

"""In-memory demo runs: scenario state, operator approvals, and staff confirmations.

The baseline track and the patient stream are computed once per run and never change.
Each staff confirmation re-simulates Track B only, with the same patients, then the
comparison is rebuilt. History is never rewritten: a confirmation's simulated effect
starts at the approved request time plus the staffing lead time, regardless of when the
reply arrives in real time.

Phase 4 moves persistence to Tiger Data; this store is process-local.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from app.simulation.arrivals import generate_patients
from app.simulation.comparison import Comparison, build_comparison
from app.simulation.engine import simulate
from app.simulation.hospitals import DEFAULT_NETWORK, Network
from app.simulation.interventions import (
    Intervention,
    LevelLoadingIntervention,
    StaffingIntervention,
)
from app.simulation.metrics import Metrics, summarize
from app.simulation.models import Proposal, Track, TrackResult
from app.simulation.scenarios import Scenario, get_scenario

log = logging.getLogger("triagex.demo")

DEFAULT_SCENARIO_ID = "i85_pileup"
DEFAULT_SEED = 42
DEFAULT_REQUEST_TTL = timedelta(minutes=10)

# Fictional demo staff. Phase 6 maps opted-in teammates' phones onto these identities.
DEMO_STAFF: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("rn-avery", "Avery (fictional RN)"),
    ("rn-jordan", "Jordan (fictional RN)"),
    ("rn-morgan", "Morgan (fictional RN)"),
    ("rn-riley", "Riley (fictional RN)"),
    ("rn-casey", "Casey (fictional RN)"),
    ("rn-quinn", "Quinn (fictional RN)"),
)
STAFF_NAMES = dict(DEMO_STAFF)


class NotFoundError(LookupError):
    pass


class ConflictError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ConfirmationRecord:
    staff_id: str
    display_name: str
    source: str  # "simulated" (dashboard fallback) or "webhook" (verified Chert reply)
    received_at: datetime
    recompute_ms: float


@dataclass(slots=True)
class StaffingRequest:
    request_id: str
    proposal_id: str
    hospital_id: str
    requested_staff: int
    proposal_tick: int  # simulated time the forecast raised the proposal
    approved_tick: int  # simulated time the operator approved; the lead time starts here
    approved_at: datetime  # wall-clock time of the approval
    expires_at: datetime
    operator: str
    confirmations: list[ConfirmationRecord] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def confirmed_staff(self) -> int:
        return len(self.confirmations)

    def intervention(self) -> StaffingIntervention:
        return StaffingIntervention(
            id=self.request_id,
            hospital_id=self.hospital_id,
            approved_tick=self.approved_tick,
            confirmed_staff=self.confirmed_staff,
        )


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OperatorAction:
    kind: str  # "outreach_approved" | "level_loading_approved"
    tick: int
    wall_time: datetime
    hospital_id: str
    proposal_id: str
    operator: str


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Run:
    run_id: str
    scenario: Scenario
    seed: int
    created_at: datetime
    network: Network
    patients: tuple
    baseline: TrackResult
    baseline_metrics: tuple[Metrics, Metrics]
    comparison: Comparison
    version: int = 1
    staffing_requests: dict[str, StaffingRequest] = field(default_factory=dict)
    level_loading: dict[str, LevelLoadingIntervention] = field(default_factory=dict)
    approved_proposals: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    actions: list[OperatorAction] = field(default_factory=list)
    recompute_history_ms: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    last_recompute_ms: float | None = None

    def interventions(self) -> tuple[Intervention, ...]:
        staffing = [r.intervention() for r in self.staffing_requests.values()]
        return (*staffing, *self.level_loading.values())

    def find_proposal(self, proposal_id: str) -> Proposal:
        for source in (self.comparison.triagex.proposals, self.baseline.proposals):
            for p in source:
                if p.id == proposal_id:
                    return p
        raise NotFoundError(f"Proposal '{proposal_id}' not found")

    def recommended_proposal(self) -> Proposal | None:
        """The demo's headline proposal: first surge-time staffing proposal at the focus
        hospital (falling back to the first surge-time staffing proposal anywhere)."""
        onset = self.scenario.surge_onset_tick
        start, end = self.scenario.demo_window
        staffing = [p for p in self.baseline.proposals if p.kind == "staffing" and p.tick >= onset]
        focus = [p for p in staffing if p.hospital_id == self.scenario.focus_hospital_id]
        in_window = [p for p in staffing if start <= p.tick < end]
        focus_in_window = [p for p in focus if start <= p.tick < end]
        for candidates in (focus_in_window, in_window, focus, staffing):
            if candidates:
                return candidates[0]
        return None

    def recompute(self) -> float:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        triagex = simulate(
            self.network, self.scenario, self.patients, self.interventions(), Track.TRIAGEX
        )
        self.comparison = build_comparison(
            self.scenario,
            self.seed,
            self.patients,
            self.baseline,
            triagex,
            self.network,
            baseline_metrics=self.baseline_metrics,
        )
        elapsed = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
        self.last_recompute_ms = elapsed
        self.recompute_history_ms.append(elapsed)
        return elapsed


class DemoService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        network: Network = DEFAULT_NETWORK,
        request_ttl: timedelta = DEFAULT_REQUEST_TTL,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
    ):
        self.network = network
        self.request_ttl = request_ttl
        self.clock = clock
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._runs: dict[str, Run] = {}
        self._active_run_id: str | None = None
        # Set by OutreachService; lets the dashboard show live-messaging state per request.
        self.messaging = None

    # --- runs -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def create_run(self, scenario_id: str = DEFAULT_SCENARIO_ID, seed: int = DEFAULT_SEED) -> Run:
        scenario = get_scenario(scenario_id)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        patients = generate_patients(self.network, scenario, seed)
        baseline = simulate(self.network, scenario, patients, (), Track.BASELINE)
        baseline_metrics = (
            summarize(baseline),
            summarize(baseline, tick_range=scenario.demo_window),
        )
        triagex = simulate(self.network, scenario, patients, (), Track.TRIAGEX)
        comparison = build_comparison(
            scenario, seed, patients, baseline, triagex, self.network, baseline_metrics
        )
        run = Run(
            run_id=uuid.uuid4().hex[:12],
            scenario=scenario,
            seed=seed,
            created_at=self.clock(),
            network=self.network,
            patients=patients,
            baseline=baseline,
            baseline_metrics=baseline_metrics,
            comparison=comparison,
        )
        run.last_recompute_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
        with self._lock:
            self._runs[run.run_id] = run
            self._active_run_id = run.run_id
        log.info("run created", extra={"run_id": run.run_id, "scenario": scenario_id, "seed": seed})
        return run

    def reset(self, scenario_id: str = DEFAULT_SCENARIO_ID, seed: int = DEFAULT_SEED) -> Run:
        """Discard every run and start the demo again from the same initial state."""
        with self._lock:
            self._runs.clear()
            self._active_run_id = None
            return self.create_run(scenario_id, seed)

    def get_run(self, run_id: str) -> Run:
        with self._lock:
            try:
                return self._runs[run_id]
            except KeyError:
                raise NotFoundError(f"Run '{run_id}' not found") from None

    def active_run(self) -> Run:
        with self._lock:
            if self._active_run_id is None:
                return self.create_run()
            return self._runs[self._active_run_id]

    # --- operator actions -----------------------------------------------------------
    def approve_proposal(
        self, run_id: str, proposal_id: str, at_tick: int, operator: str = "operator"
    ) -> tuple[Run, str]:
        """Approve a proposal at simulated tick `at_tick` (the playhead when the operator
        clicked). The 45-minute staffing lead time starts at `at_tick`, never at the
        proposal tick. Returns the run and the created request/intervention id."""
        with self._lock:
            run = self.get_run(run_id)
            proposal = run.find_proposal(proposal_id)
            if proposal_id in run.approved_proposals:
                raise ConflictError(f"Proposal '{proposal_id}' is already approved")
            tick = at_tick
            if not (proposal.tick <= tick < run.scenario.horizon_ticks):
                raise ConflictError(
                    f"Approval tick {tick} must be between the proposal tick {proposal.tick} "
                    f"and the end of the horizon"
                )
            now = self.clock()
            if proposal.kind == "staffing":
                request_id = f"req-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
                run.staffing_requests[request_id] = StaffingRequest(
                    request_id=request_id,
                    proposal_id=proposal.id,
                    hospital_id=proposal.hospital_id,
                    requested_staff=proposal.recommended_staff or 1,
                    proposal_tick=proposal.tick,
                    approved_tick=tick,
                    approved_at=now,
                    expires_at=now + self.request_ttl,
                    operator=operator,
                )
                created = request_id
                kind = "outreach_approved"
            else:
                created = f"ll-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
                run.level_loading[created] = LevelLoadingIntervention(
                    id=created, source_hospital_id=proposal.hospital_id, approved_tick=tick
                )
                kind = "level_loading_approved"
                run.recompute()
            run.approved_proposals.add(proposal.id)
            run.actions.append(
                OperatorAction(kind, tick, now, proposal.hospital_id, proposal.id, operator)
            )
            run.version += 1
            log.info(
                "proposal approved",
                extra={"run_id": run.run_id, "proposal_id": proposal.id, "tick": tick},
            )
            return run, created

    def simulate_reply(
        self, run_id: str, request_id: str, staff_id: str | None = None, reply: str = "IN"
    ) -> tuple[Run, ConfirmationRecord]:
        """Dashboard fallback for a staff reply. Always labeled as simulated."""
        return self._record_reply(run_id, request_id, staff_id, reply, source="simulated")

    def confirm_live(
        self, run_id: str, request_id: str, staff_id: str, display_name: str, reply: str
    ) -> tuple[Run, ConfirmationRecord]:
        """A verified Chert webhook reply. Same validation and recompute as the fallback."""
        return self._record_reply(
            run_id, request_id, staff_id, reply, source="webhook", display_name=display_name
        )

    def touch(self, run_id: str) -> Run:
        """Bump the version after a change outside the simulation (e.g. outreach sent), so
        dashboards refetch and the change is persisted as its own version."""
        with self._lock:
            run = self.get_run(run_id)
            run.version += 1
            return run

    def _record_reply(
        self,
        run_id: str,
        request_id: str,
        staff_id: str | None,
        reply: str,
        source: str,
        display_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Run, ConfirmationRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            run = self.get_run(run_id)
            request = run.staffing_requests.get(request_id)
            if request is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"Staffing request '{request_id}' not found")
            if reply.strip().upper() != "IN":
                raise ConflictError("Only the reply 'IN' confirms a demo shift")
            now = self.clock()
            if now >= request.expires_at:
                raise ConflictError(f"Staffing request '{request_id}' has expired")
            if request.confirmed_staff >= request.requested_staff:
                raise ConflictError(f"Staffing request '{request_id}' is already fully confirmed")
            confirmed_ids = {c.staff_id for c in request.confirmations}
            if source == "webhook":
                if not staff_id or not display_name:
                    raise ConflictError("A live confirmation needs a recipient identity")
                if staff_id in confirmed_ids:
                    raise ConflictError("This recipient has already confirmed this request")
            elif staff_id is None:
                staff_id = next((sid for sid, _ in DEMO_STAFF if sid not in confirmed_ids), None)
                if staff_id is None:
                    raise ConflictError("Every fictional demo staff member has already replied")
            elif staff_id not in STAFF_NAMES:
                raise NotFoundError(f"Unknown demo staff member '{staff_id}'")
            elif staff_id in confirmed_ids:
                raise ConflictError(f"'{staff_id}' has already confirmed this request")

            name = display_name if source == "webhook" else STAFF_NAMES[staff_id]
            record = ConfirmationRecord(staff_id, name, source, now, 0.0)
            request.confirmations.append(record)
            record.recompute_ms = run.recompute()
            run.version += 1
            log.info(
                "staff confirmed",
                extra={
                    "run_id": run.run_id,
                    "request_id": request_id,
                    "source": source,
                    "confirmed": request.confirmed_staff,
                    "recompute_ms": record.recompute_ms,
                },
            )
            return run, record

    def request_status(self, request: StaffingRequest) -> str:
        if request.confirmed_staff >= request.requested_staff:
            return "fully_confirmed"
        if self.clock() >= request.expires_at:
            return "expired"
        return "partially_confirmed" if request.confirmed_staff else "awaiting_replies"

"""Chert integration endpoints: signed inbound webhook, credential check, outbound delivery.

POST /api/webhooks/chert            Chert -> TriageX (message.received), signature-verified
POST /api/integrations/chert/check  re-run the credential check against Chert

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time

from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.concurrency import run_in_threadpool
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.repositories.messaging import OutreachRow, WebhookRow
from app.repositories.persistence import build_snapshot
from app.services.dashboard import build_dashboard
from app.services.demo_service import NotFoundError, Run
from app.services.outreach import OutreachRecord, OutreachService

router = APIRouter(tags=["chert"])
log = logging.getLogger("triagex.chert")


def _outreach(app: FastAPI) -> OutreachService:
    return app.state.outreach


def _submit(app: FastAPI, item) -> None:
    writer = app.state.persistence
    if writer.enabled:
        try:
            writer.submit(item)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("could not queue messaging row")


async def publish_run(app: FastAPI, run: Run, reason: str) -> None:
    """Persist a snapshot of the run and notify every dashboard (same path as the API)."""
    state = build_dashboard(app.state.demo_service, run)
    _submit(app, build_snapshot(run, state, reason))
    await app.state.ws_manager.broadcast(
        {
            "type": "run.updated",
            "run_id": run.run_id,
            "version": run.version,
            "reason": reason,
            "recompute_ms": run.last_recompute_ms,
        }
    )


def start_outreach(app: FastAPI, run: Run, request_id: str) -> int:
    """Called after an approval. Sends nothing unless live messaging is configured. Delivery
    runs in the background so the approval response never waits on Chert."""
    records = _outreach(app).prepare(run, request_id)
    if not records:
        return 0
    for r in records:
        _submit(app, OutreachRow.of(r))
    task = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(_deliver(app, run.run_id, records))
    tasks: set = app.state.background_tasks
    tasks.add(task)
    task.add_done_callback(tasks.discard)
    return len(records)


async def _deliver(app: FastAPI, run_id: str, records: list[OutreachRecord]) -> None:
    try:
        await run_in_threadpool(_outreach(app).deliver, records)
    except Exception:
        log.exception("outreach delivery crashed")
        for r in records:
            if r.status == "sending":
                r.status, r.error = "failed", "delivery crashed"
    for r in records:
        _submit(app, OutreachRow.of(r))
    try:
        run = app.state.demo_service.touch(run_id)
    except NotFoundError:  # the demo was reset meanwhile
        return
    await publish_run(app, run, "outreach_sent")


@router.post("/webhooks/chert")
async def chert_webhook(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    raw = await request.body()  # verified byte-for-byte; never re-serialized
    outreach = _outreach(request.app)
    outcome = await run_in_threadpool(outreach.handle_webhook, raw, dict(request.headers))
    if outcome.outcome != "not_configured":
        _submit(request.app, WebhookRow.of(outcome))
    body = {"outcome": outcome.outcome, "detail": outcome.detail, "event_id": outcome.event_id}
    if outcome.run is not None:
        if outcome.record is not None:
            _submit(request.app, OutreachRow.of(outcome.record))
        await publish_run(request.app, outcome.run, "staff_confirmed_live")
        body["version"] = outcome.run.version
    body["server_ms"] = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
    return JSONResponse(body, status_code=outcome.http_status)


@router.post("/integrations/chert/check")
async def chert_check(request: Request) -> dict:
    outreach = _outreach(request.app)
    await run_in_threadpool(outreach.check_connection)
    status, detail = outreach.health()
    return {"status": status, "detail": detail, "checked_at": outreach.checked_at}

def writer_from_settings() -> PersistenceWriter:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.database_url:
        return PersistenceWriter(None)
    db = Database(
        settings.database_url,
        schema=settings.database_schema,
        pool_size=settings.database_pool_size,
        timeout_seconds=settings.database_timeout_seconds,
    )
    log.info("database configured", extra={"target": db.redacted_url})
    return PersistenceWriter(db)


def create_app(
    demo_service: DemoService | None = None,
    persistence: PersistenceWriter | None = None,
    outreach: OutreachService | None = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()
    configure_logging(settings.log_level)
    owns_writer = persistence is None
    writer = writer_from_settings() if owns_writer else persistence
    demo = outreach.demo if outreach is not None else (demo_service or DemoService())
    if outreach is None:
        outreach = OutreachService(demo, ChertConfig.from_settings(settings))

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
        writer.start()  # connects and migrates in the background; never blocks startup
        if outreach.client is not None:  # ask Chert whether the credentials work
            threading.Thread(
                target=outreach.check_connection, name="triagex-chert-check", daemon=True
            ).start()
        yield
        if owns_writer:  # an injected writer (tests, scripts) is managed by its owner
            writer.stop()
            if writer.db is not None:
                writer.db.close()

    app = FastAPI(title=f"{APP_NAME} API", version="0.4.0", lifespan=lifespan)
    app.state.demo_service = demo
    app.state.outreach = outreach
    app.state.background_tasks = set()
    app.state.persistence = writer
    app.state.ws_manager = ConnectionManager()
    app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=2048)
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=settings.cors_origin_list,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )
    app.include_router(health_router, prefix="/api")
    app.include_router(reference_router, prefix="/api")
    app.include_router(runs_router, prefix="/api")
    app.include_router(db_router, prefix="/api")
    app.include_router(meta_router, prefix="/api")
    app.include_router(chert_router, prefix="/api")
    app.include_router(ws_router)
    return app

    database_timeout_seconds: float = 10.0

    # AI providers (Phase 5)
    openai_api_key: str | None = None
    openai_model: str | None = None
    gemini_api_key: str | None = None
    gemini_model: str | None = None

"""Response schemas for the single-screen TriageX dashboard.
One `DashboardState` carries everything the command center renders: map, synchronized
comparison curves, coordination feed, proposal cards, and the hero impact metric. All
numbers are computed by the simulation; the frontend never derives deltas itself.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
TrackName = Literal["baseline", "triagex"]
StatusName = Literal["normal", "pressure", "breach"]
Origin = Literal["simulation", "operator", "simulated_reply", "webhook", "live_message"]
Severity = Literal["info", "warning", "critical", "success"]
CurvePhase = Literal["before_intervention", "staff_en_route", "shift_active", "after_shift"]
class ScenarioSummary(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    focus_hospital_id: str
    surge_onset_tick: int
class RunInfo(BaseModel):
    run_id: str
    version: int = Field(description="Increments on every change to the run's state")
    scenario: ScenarioSummary
    seed: int
    created_at: datetime
    notice: str
class TimeWindow(BaseModel):
    start_tick: int
    end_tick: int  # exclusive
    start_clock: str
    end_clock: str
class Timeline(BaseModel):
    tick_minutes: int
    horizon_ticks: int
    clocks: list[str] = Field(description="Clock label for every tick in the 24-hour horizon")
    demo_window: TimeWindow
    suggested_ms_per_tick: int
class HospitalInfo(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    short_name: str
    lat: float
    lon: float
    treatment_spaces: int
    base_staff: int
class HospitalPoint(BaseModel):
    tick: int
    status: StatusName
    saturation_pct: float
    occupied: int
    queue_length: int
    ambulances_waiting: int
    staff_on_duty: int
    staffed_capacity: int
    mean_wait_minutes: float
    forecast_saturation_pct: float
    diverting: bool
class HospitalSeries(BaseModel):
    hospital_id: str
    baseline: list[HospitalPoint]
    triagex: list[HospitalPoint]
class CurvePoint(BaseModel):
    """One tick of the six-hour demo window, both futures side by side."""
    tick: int
    clock: str
    phase: CurvePhase
    diverged: bool
    baseline_focus_saturation_pct: float
    triagex_focus_saturation_pct: float
    baseline_patients_waiting: int
    triagex_patients_waiting: int
    baseline_ambulances_waiting: int
    triagex_ambulances_waiting: int
    baseline_ambulance_hours_cumulative: float
    triagex_ambulance_hours_cumulative: float
    ambulance_hours_saved_so_far: float
class Curves(BaseModel):
    focus_hospital_id: str
    window: TimeWindow
    points: list[CurvePoint]
class Band(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["demo_window", "staff_lead_time", "shift_active", "level_loading_active"]
    start_tick: int
    end_tick: int
    label: str
    hospital_id: str | None = None
class Marker(BaseModel):
    tick: int
    clock: str
    kind: str
    label: str
    hospital_id: str | None = None
    in_demo_window: bool = True
class StatusTransition(BaseModel):
    tick: int
    clock: str
    track: TrackName
    hospital_id: str
    from_status: StatusName
    to_status: StatusName
class Flow(BaseModel):
    """Ambulances rerouted between hospitals in one tick (for map animation)."""
    tick: int
    track: TrackName
    from_hospital_id: str
    to_hospital_id: str
    kind: Literal["diversion", "level_loading"]
    count: int
    travel_ticks: int
class FeedEvent(BaseModel):
    id: str
    tick: int
    clock: str
    title: str
    detail: str
    kind: str
    track: Literal["both", "baseline", "triagex"]
    origin: Origin
    severity: Severity
    hospital_id: str | None = None
    wall_time: datetime | None = None
    in_demo_window: bool = True
class ProposalCard(BaseModel):
    id: str
    kind: Literal["staffing", "level_loading"]
    hospital_id: str
    tick: int
    clock: str
    title: str
    rationale: str
    forecast_saturation_pct: float
    current_saturation_pct: float
    recommended_staff: int | None
    status: Literal["available", "approved"]
    recommended: bool
class Confirmation(BaseModel):
    staff_id: str
    display_name: str
    source: Literal["simulated", "webhook"]
    received_at: datetime
class OutreachView(BaseModel):
    """One live iMessage to an opted-in recipient (the number is never exposed)."""
    outreach_id: str
    recipient: str  # masked, e.g. "•••1234"
    status: Literal["sending", "sent", "failed", "confirmed"]
    sent_at: datetime | None = None
    confirmed_at: datetime | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    send_ms: float | None = None
class MessagingView(BaseModel):
    """Whether live Chert outreach is available. `live` is true only after Chert accepted
    the credentials and every inbound prerequisite is configured."""
    live: bool = False
    status: Literal["ok", "starting", "not_configured", "error"] = "not_configured"
    detail: str = "Live iMessage not configured"
    recipients: int = 0
    last_webhook_outcome: str | None = None
    last_webhook_ms: float | None = None
class StaffingRequestView(BaseModel):
    request_id: str
    proposal_id: str
    hospital_id: str
    requested_staff: int
    confirmed_staff: int
    usable_staff: int
    proposal_tick: int
    proposal_clock: str
    status: Literal["awaiting_replies", "partially_confirmed", "fully_confirmed", "expired"]
    approved_tick: int
    approved_clock: str
    effective_tick: int
    effective_clock: str
    end_tick: int
    approved_at: datetime
    expires_at: datetime
    confirmations: list[Confirmation]
    outreach: list[OutreachView] = []
class HeroMetric(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    unit: str
    baseline: float
    triagex: float
    delta: float
    pct_change: float | None
    lower_is_better: bool
    improved: bool | None
    headline: str
class RecoveryView(BaseModel):
    hospital_id: str
    baseline_recovered_tick: int | None
    triagex_recovered_tick: int | None
    baseline_recovered_clock: str | None
    triagex_recovered_clock: str | None
    minutes_sooner: int | None
    baseline_breach_hours: float
    triagex_breach_hours: float
    headline: str
class Impact(BaseModel):
    state: Literal["awaiting_intervention", "intervention_scheduled"]
    primary: HeroMetric
    secondary: list[HeroMetric]
    recovery: RecoveryView
    window: TimeWindow
class Divergence(BaseModel):
    tick: int
    clock: str
class Meta(BaseModel):
    generated_at: datetime
    recompute_ms: float | None
    build_ms: float
class DashboardState(BaseModel):
    run: RunInfo
    timeline: Timeline
    hospitals: list[HospitalInfo]
    series: list[HospitalSeries]
    curves: Curves
    bands: list[Band]
    markers: list[Marker]
    transitions: list[StatusTransition]
    flows: list[Flow]
    feed: list[FeedEvent]
    proposals: list[ProposalCard]
    staffing_requests: list[StaffingRequestView]
    impact: Impact
    divergence: Divergence | None
    messaging: MessagingView = MessagingView()
    meta: Meta
class ForecastAccuracy(BaseModel):
    horizon_minutes: int
    samples: int
    bias_pct_points: float
    mean_absolute_error_pct_points: float
class Diagnostics(BaseModel):
    """Engineering detail for development and judge Q&A, kept off the main screen."""
    run_id: str
    version: int
    scenario_assumptions: list[str]
    model_limitations: list[str]
    forecast_accuracy: ForecastAccuracy
    all_proposals: list[ProposalCard]
    intervention_effects: list[dict]
    full_horizon_metrics: dict[str, dict]
    demo_window_metrics: dict[str, dict]
    track_digests: dict[str, str]
    recompute_history_ms: list[float]

def _requests(service: DemoService, run: Run) -> list[StaffingRequestView]:
    out = []
    for r in run.staffing_requests.values():
        effect = next(
            (e for e in run.comparison.intervention_effects if e.intervention_id == r.request_id),
            None,
        )
        iv = r.intervention()
        out.append(
            StaffingRequestView(
                request_id=r.request_id,
                proposal_id=r.proposal_id,
                hospital_id=r.hospital_id,
                requested_staff=r.requested_staff,
                confirmed_staff=r.confirmed_staff,
                usable_staff=effect.usable_staff if effect and effect.usable_staff else 0,
                status=service.request_status(r),
                proposal_tick=r.proposal_tick,
                proposal_clock=run.scenario.clock_label(r.proposal_tick),
                approved_tick=r.approved_tick,
                approved_clock=run.scenario.clock_label(r.approved_tick),
                effective_tick=iv.effective_tick,
                effective_clock=run.scenario.clock_label(iv.effective_tick),
                end_tick=iv.end_tick,
                approved_at=r.approved_at,
                expires_at=r.expires_at,
                confirmations=[
                    Confirmation(
                        staff_id=c.staff_id,
                        display_name=c.display_name,
                        source=c.source,
                        received_at=c.received_at,
                    )
                    for c in r.confirmations
                ],
                outreach=_outreach(service, r.request_id),
            )  # fmt: skip
        )
    return out


def _feed(service: DemoService, run: Run, divergence: int | None) -> list[FeedEvent]:
    sc, c, net = run.scenario, run.comparison, run.network
    label = sc.clock_label
    events: list[tuple[int, int, FeedEvent]] = []

    def add(rank: int, **kw) -> None:
        tick = kw["tick"]
        kw.setdefault("clock", label(tick))
        kw.setdefault("id", f"{kw['kind']}:{tick}:{kw.get('hospital_id') or ''}:{len(events)}")
        events.append((tick, rank, FeedEvent(**kw)))

    add(
        0,
        tick=sc.surge_onset_tick,
        title="Surge Begins",
        detail=sc.name,
        kind="surge_onset",
        track="both",
        origin="simulation",
        severity="warning",
    )
    for p in c.triagex.proposals:
        if p.kind != "staffing":
            continue
        name = net.get(p.hospital_id).short_name
        add(1, tick=p.tick, title="Surge Predicted",
            detail=f"{name}: 2-hour forecast {p.forecast_saturation_pct:.0f}% of treatment spaces",
            kind="surge_predicted", track="triagex", origin="simulation",
            severity="critical" if p.forecast_saturation_pct >= 100 else "warning",
            hospital_id=p.hospital_id)  # fmt: skip
    recommended = run.recommended_proposal()
    if recommended is not None:
        add(1, tick=recommended.tick, title="Outreach Proposed",
            detail=_proposal_title(run, recommended.kind, recommended.hospital_id,
                                   recommended.recommended_staff),
            kind="outreach_proposed", track="triagex", origin="simulation", severity="warning",
            hospital_id=recommended.hospital_id)  # fmt: skip
    for a in run.actions:
        name = net.get(a.hospital_id).short_name
        if a.kind == "outreach_approved":
            title = "Outreach Approved"
            detail = (
                f"Staff outreach approved for {name}; confirmed staff on the floor by "
                f"{label(a.tick + STAFF_LEAD_TICKS)}"
            )
        else:
            title, detail = "Level-Loading Approved", f"Redirect low-acuity ambulances from {name}"
        add(
            2,
            tick=a.tick,
            title=title,
            detail=detail,
            kind=a.kind,
            track="triagex",
            origin="operator",
            severity="info",
            hospital_id=a.hospital_id,
            wall_time=a.wall_time,
        )
    for r in run.staffing_requests.values():
        name = net.get(r.hospital_id).short_name
        sent = [o for o in (service.messaging.records_for(r.request_id) if service.messaging
                            else []) if o.sent_at is not None]  # fmt: skip
        if sent:
            add(3, tick=r.approved_tick, title="iMessage Sent",
                detail=(f"TriageX DEMO outreach delivered to Chert for {len(sent)} opted-in "
                        f"teammate{'s' if len(sent) != 1 else ''} "
                        f"({', '.join(o.masked for o in sent)})"),
                kind="outreach_sent", track="triagex", origin="live_message", severity="info",
                hospital_id=r.hospital_id, wall_time=min(o.sent_at for o in sent))  # fmt: skip
        for i, conf in enumerate(r.confirmations, start=1):
            add(
                3,
                tick=r.approved_tick,
                title="Staff Confirmed",
                detail=(
                    f"{conf.display_name} confirmed for {name} ({i}/{r.requested_staff})"
                    + (" via simulated reply" if conf.source != "webhook"
                       else " via live iMessage reply")  # fmt: skip
                ),
                kind="staff_confirmed",
                track="triagex",
                origin="webhook" if conf.source == "webhook" else "simulated_reply",
                severity="success",
                hospital_id=r.hospital_id,
                wall_time=conf.received_at,
            )
            add(3, tick=r.approved_tick, title="Capacity Recalculated",
                detail=f"With TriageX future recalculated in {conf.recompute_ms:.0f} ms",
                kind="recalculated", track="triagex", origin="simulation", severity="info",
                hospital_id=r.hospital_id, wall_time=conf.received_at)  # fmt: skip
        if r.confirmed_staff:
            iv = r.intervention()
            add(3, tick=r.approved_tick, title="Staff En Route",
                detail=(f"{r.confirmed_staff} confirmed staff heading to {name}; "
                        f"shift starts {label(iv.effective_tick)}"),
                kind="staff_en_route", track="triagex", origin="simulation", severity="info",
                hospital_id=r.hospital_id)  # fmt: skip
    # Diversion events identical in both futures are shown once, as "both".
    diversion_keys = {
        name: {(e.tick, e.kind, e.hospital_id) for e in track.events
               if e.kind in (EventKind.DIVERSION_START, EventKind.DIVERSION_END)}
        for name, track in (("baseline", c.baseline), ("triagex", c.triagex))
    }  # fmt: skip
    shared = diversion_keys["baseline"] & diversion_keys["triagex"]
    for track_name, track in (("baseline", c.baseline), ("triagex", c.triagex)):


def _messaging(service: DemoService) -> MessagingView:
    outreach = service.messaging
    if outreach is None:
        return MessagingView()
    status, detail = outreach.health()
    last = outreach.last_webhook
    return MessagingView(
        live=status == "ok",
        status=status,
        detail=detail,
        recipients=len(outreach.config.allowed_phones),
        last_webhook_outcome=last.outcome if last else None,
        last_webhook_ms=last.processing_ms if last else None,
    )


def _outreach(service: DemoService, request_id: str) -> list[OutreachView]:
    if service.messaging is None:
        return []
    return [
        OutreachView(
            outreach_id=r.outreach_id, recipient=r.masked, status=r.status, sent_at=r.sent_at,
            confirmed_at=r.confirmed_at, error=r.error, send_ms=r.send_ms,
        )  # fmt: skip
        for r in service.messaging.records_for(request_id)
    ]


def build_dashboard(service: DemoService, run: Run) -> DashboardState:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    sc, c = run.scenario, run.comparison
    divergence = c.first_divergence_tick
    curves = _curves(run, divergence)
    state = DashboardState(
        run=RunInfo(
            run_id=run.run_id,
            version=run.version,
            seed=run.seed,
            created_at=run.created_at,
            notice=SYNTHETIC_DATA_NOTICE,
            scenario=ScenarioSummary(
                id=sc.id,
                name=sc.name,
                description=sc.description,
                focus_hospital_id=sc.focus_hospital_id,
                surge_onset_tick=sc.surge_onset_tick,
            ),
        ),  # fmt: skip
        timeline=Timeline(
            tick_minutes=TICK_MINUTES,
            horizon_ticks=sc.horizon_ticks,
            clocks=[sc.clock_label(t) for t in range(sc.horizon_ticks)],
            demo_window=_window(run),
            suggested_ms_per_tick=SUGGESTED_MS_PER_TICK,
        ),  # fmt: skip
        hospitals=[
            HospitalInfo(
                id=h.id,
                name=h.name,
                short_name=h.short_name,
                lat=h.lat,
                lon=h.lon,
                treatment_spaces=h.treatment_spaces,
                base_staff=h.base_staff,
            )
            for h in run.network.hospitals
        ],  # fmt: skip
        series=[
            HospitalSeries(
                hospital_id=hid,
                baseline=[_point(r) for r in c.baseline.hospital_series(hid)],
                triagex=[_point(r) for r in c.triagex.hospital_series(hid)],
            )
            for hid in c.baseline.hospital_ids
        ],
        curves=curves,
        bands=_bands(run),
        markers=_markers(run),
        transitions=_transitions(run),
        flows=_flows(run),
        feed=_feed(service, run, divergence),
        proposals=_cards(run, only_window=True),
        staffing_requests=_requests(service, run),
        impact=_impact(run, curves),
        divergence=Divergence(tick=divergence, clock=sc.clock_label(divergence))
        if divergence is not None
        else None,
        messaging=_messaging(service),
        meta=Meta(generated_at=datetime.now(UTC), recompute_ms=run.last_recompute_ms, build_ms=0),
    )
    state.meta.build_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
    return state

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from app.config import REPO_ROOT
from app.repositories.db import Database

log = logging.getLogger("triagex.migrations")

MIGRATIONS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "db" / "migrations"
HYPERTABLE = "hospital_metrics"
HYPERTABLE_TIME_COLUMN = "ts"
HYPERTABLE_CHUNK_INTERVAL = "1 day"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class MigrationReport:
    applied: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    already_applied: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    timescaledb_version: str | None = None
    hypertable: bool = False
    hypertable_note: str = ""


def migration_files(directory: Path = MIGRATIONS_DIR) -> list[Path]:
    return sorted(directory.glob("[0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.sql"))


def hypertable_statement(table: str = HYPERTABLE) -> str:
    """create_hypertable works on every TimescaleDB 2.x, including Tiger Cloud."""
    return (
        f"SELECT create_hypertable('{table}', '{HYPERTABLE_TIME_COLUMN}', "
        f"chunk_time_interval => INTERVAL '{HYPERTABLE_CHUNK_INTERVAL}', "
        f"if_not_exists => TRUE, migrate_data => TRUE)"
    )


def _timescaledb_version(con) -> str | None:
    rows = con.run("SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'timescaledb'")
    if rows:
        return rows[0][0]
    available = con.run("SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name = 'timescaledb'")
    if not available:
        return None
    try:
        con.run("CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb")
    except Exception as exc:  # e.g. insufficient privilege
        log.warning("timescaledb is available but could not be enabled: %s", exc)
        con.run("ROLLBACK")
        return None
