"""FaceTime staff verification: the agent reports card fields, TriageX decides.

The agent (agent/) reads a fictional staff card from the caller's live FaceTime video and
sends only the extracted text fields here. This service is the authority:

1. card_check(): validates the card against the synthetic roster
   (backend/app/data/staff_roster.json) and the active staffing request, and records the
   check (fields only; no images, no phone numbers).
2. confirm(): after a valid check on the same call within CHECK_TTL, and only with the
   caller's explicit verbal confirmation, records the confirmation exactly once through
   DemoService.confirm_live(source="facetime"): the same validation, expiry and recompute
   path as the simulated button and the iMessage webhook.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import re
import threading
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from app.services.demo_service import (
    STAFF_NAMES,
    ConflictError,
    DemoService,
    NotFoundError,
    Run,
    StaffingRequest,
)

log = logging.getLogger("triagex.facetime")

ROSTER_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "staff_roster.json"
CHECK_TTL = timedelta(minutes=2)
MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.8
# What the caller may say, as normalized by the agent; anything else never confirms.
VERBAL_CONFIRMATIONS = {"confirm", "i confirm"}
MAX_CALLS = 200
MAX_CHECKS = 500


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class RosterEntry:
    card_id: str
    staff_id: str
    name: str
    role: str
    unit: str
    availability: str
    shift: str | None


def load_roster(path: Path = ROSTER_PATH) -> dict[str, RosterEntry]:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    roster = {}
    for s in data["staff"]:
        entry = RosterEntry(
            card_id=s["card_id"].upper(), staff_id=s["staff_id"], name=s["name"],
            role=s["role"], unit=s["unit"], availability=s["availability"].upper(),
            shift=s.get("shift"),
        )  # fmt: skip
        if entry.staff_id not in STAFF_NAMES:
            raise ValueError(f"Roster staff_id '{entry.staff_id}' is not a DEMO_STAFF member")
        roster[entry.card_id] = entry
    return roster


def normalize_card_id(value: str | None) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[\s‐-―−._-]+", "-", (value or "").strip().upper()).strip("-")


def _role_matches(read_role: str | None, roster_role: str) -> bool:
    """The card's role must name the roster role's profession. Text read from a camera is
    noisy (a live read gave "Nurse - Emergency" for "Registered Nurse · Emergency"), so a
    missing role is allowed and a read role needs only one of the roster role's words."""
    if not read_role:
        return True
    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", read_role.casefold()))
    return bool(words & set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", roster_role.casefold())))


# Reasons and what the agent should say. The message never claims anything the backend
# did not decide.
REASONS = {
    "valid": "on the TriageX DEMO roster and available",
    "no_active_request": "there is no open TriageX DEMO staffing request right now",
    "low_confidence": "the card was not read clearly enough",
    "not_on_roster": "is not on the TriageX DEMO roster",
    "off_duty": "is on the roster but marked OFF DUTY",
    "role_mismatch": "does not match the roster role",
    "already_confirmed": "has already confirmed this request",
    "request_full": "the staffing request is already fully confirmed",
    "request_expired": "the staffing request has expired",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CardCheck:
    check_id: str
    call_id: str
    run_id: str | None
    request_id: str | None
    card_id: str
    read_name: str | None
    read_role: str | None
    read_availability: str | None
    confidence: float
    valid: bool
    reason: str
    staff_id: str | None
    display_name: str | None
    checked_at: datetime

    @property
    def message(self) -> str:
        who = f"Card {self.card_id}"
        if self.valid:
            return f"{who} ({self.display_name}) is {REASONS['valid']}."
        if self.reason in ("not_on_roster", "off_duty", "role_mismatch", "already_confirmed"):
            return f"{who} {REASONS[self.reason]}."
        return f"{who} cannot be accepted: {REASONS[self.reason]}."


@dataclass(slots=True)
class FaceTimeCall:
    call_id: str
    run_id: str | None
    connected_at: datetime
    status: str = "connected"  # connected | ended
    ended_at: datetime | None = None
    checks: list[CardCheck] = field(default_factory=list)
    confirmed_staff_ids: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ConfirmResult:
    confirmed: bool
    duplicate: bool
    reason: str
    message: str
    run: Run | None = None  # set only when this call changed the run
    staff_id: str | None = None
    display_name: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    confirmed_count: int | None = None
    requested: int | None = None
    effective_clock: str | None = None


class FaceTimeService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        demo: DemoService,
        roster: dict[str, RosterEntry] | None = None,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
    ):
        self.demo = demo
        self.roster = roster if roster is not None else load_roster()
        self.clock = clock
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._calls: dict[str, FaceTimeCall] = {}
        demo.facetime = self

    # --- queries ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def open_request(self, run: Run) -> StaffingRequest | None:
        """The most recently approved request that can still take confirmations."""
        open_ = [r for r in run.staffing_requests.values()
                 if self.demo.request_status(r) in ("awaiting_replies", "partially_confirmed")]  # fmt: skip
        return max(open_, key=lambda r: r.approved_at, default=None)

    def calls_for_run(self, run_id: str) -> list[FaceTimeCall]:
        with self._lock:
            return [c for c in self._calls.values() if c.run_id == run_id]

    def checks_for_request(self, request_id: str) -> list[CardCheck]:
        with self._lock:
            return [k for c in self._calls.values() for k in c.checks if k.request_id == request_id]

    # --- call lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def call_event(self, call_id: str, event: str) -> FaceTimeCall:
        with self._lock:
            call = self._call(call_id)
            if event == "ended" and call.status != "ended":
                call.status, call.ended_at = "ended", self.clock()
            elif event == "connected" and call.status == "ended":
                call.status, call.ended_at = "connected", None
            return call

    def _call(self, call_id: str) -> FaceTimeCall:
        call = self._calls.get(call_id)
        if call is None:
            run_id = self.demo.active_run().run_id
            call = FaceTimeCall(call_id=call_id, run_id=run_id, connected_at=self.clock())
            self._calls[call_id] = call
            while len(self._calls) > MAX_CALLS:
                self._calls.pop(next(iter(self._calls)))
        return call

    # --- card check -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def card_check(
        self,
        call_id: str,
        card_id: str,
        name: str | None,
        role: str | None,
        availability: str | None,
        confidence: float,
    ) -> CardCheck:
        with self._lock:
            call = self._call(call_id)
            run = self.demo.active_run()
            request = self.open_request(run)
            cid = normalize_card_id(card_id)
            entry = self.roster.get(cid)
            reason = "valid"
            if request is None:
                reason = self._closed_reason(run)
            elif confidence < MIN_CONFIDENCE:
                reason = "low_confidence"
            elif entry is None:
                reason = "not_on_roster"
            elif entry.availability != "AVAILABLE":
                reason = "off_duty"
            elif not _role_matches(role, entry.role):
                reason = "role_mismatch"
            elif entry.staff_id in {c.staff_id for c in request.confirmations}:
                reason = "already_confirmed"
            check = CardCheck(
                check_id=f"chk-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",
                call_id=call_id,
                run_id=run.run_id,
                request_id=request.request_id if request else None,
                card_id=cid,
                read_name=name,
                read_role=role,
                read_availability=availability,
                confidence=confidence,
                valid=reason == "valid",
                reason=reason,
                staff_id=entry.staff_id if entry else None,
                display_name=entry.name if entry else None,
                checked_at=self.clock(),
            )
            call.run_id = run.run_id
            call.checks.append(check)
            del call.checks[:-MAX_CHECKS]
            log.info("card check", extra={"call_id": call_id, "card_id": cid,
                                          "valid": check.valid, "reason": reason})  # fmt: skip
            return check

    def _closed_reason(self, run: Run) -> str:
        latest = max(run.staffing_requests.values(), key=lambda r: r.approved_at, default=None)
        if latest is None:
            return "no_active_request"
        status = self.demo.request_status(latest)
        return {"fully_confirmed": "request_full", "expired": "request_expired"}.get(
            status, "no_active_request"
        )

    # --- confirmation -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def confirm(self, call_id: str, card_id: str, verbal_confirmation: str) -> ConfirmResult:
        """Record the caller's confirmation exactly once. Requires a valid card check on this
        call, for this card, within CHECK_TTL, on the active run's open request."""
        verbal = " ".join(verbal_confirmation.casefold().split()).strip(" .!")
        cid = normalize_card_id(card_id)
        with self._lock:
            call = self._calls.get(call_id)
            if verbal not in VERBAL_CONFIRMATIONS:
                return ConfirmResult(False, False, "no_verbal_confirmation",
                                     "The caller has not said 'I confirm'.")  # fmt: skip
            check = None
            if call is not None:
                now = self.clock()
                check = next((k for k in reversed(call.checks)
                              if k.card_id == cid and now - k.checked_at <= CHECK_TTL), None)  # fmt: skip
            if check is None:
                return ConfirmResult(False, False, "no_prior_check",
                                     f"Card {cid} has no recent card check on this call.")  # fmt: skip
            if not check.valid:
                return ConfirmResult(False, False, check.reason, check.message)
            assert call is not None and check.staff_id and check.request_id and check.run_id
            run = self.demo.get_run(check.run_id) if self._run_exists(check.run_id) else None
            if run is None or run.run_id != self.demo.active_run().run_id:
                return ConfirmResult(False, False, "stale_run",
                                     "The demo was reset after this card check.")  # fmt: skip
            request = run.staffing_requests.get(check.request_id)
            if check.staff_id in call.confirmed_staff_ids or (
                request is not None
                and any(c.staff_id == check.staff_id and c.source == "facetime"
                        for c in request.confirmations)  # fmt: skip
            ):
                return self._result(run, request, check, confirmed=True, duplicate=True,
                                    reason="duplicate", changed=False)  # fmt: skip
            try:
                run, _ = self.demo.confirm_live(
                    run.run_id, check.request_id, check.staff_id, check.display_name or
                    STAFF_NAMES[check.staff_id], "IN", source="facetime",
                )  # fmt: skip
            except (ConflictError, NotFoundError) as exc:
                return ConfirmResult(False, False, "rejected_request", str(exc))
            call.confirmed_staff_ids.add(check.staff_id)
            request = run.staffing_requests[check.request_id]
            log.info("facetime confirmation", extra={"call_id": call_id, "staff_id": check.staff_id,
                                                     "confirmed": request.confirmed_staff})  # fmt: skip
            return self._result(run, request, check, confirmed=True, duplicate=False,
                                reason="confirmed", changed=True)  # fmt: skip

    def _run_exists(self, run_id: str) -> bool:
        try:
            self.demo.get_run(run_id)
            return True
        except NotFoundError:
            return False

    def _result(self, run: Run, request: StaffingRequest | None, check: CardCheck, *,
                confirmed: bool, duplicate: bool, reason: str, changed: bool) -> ConfirmResult:  # fmt: skip
        effective = None
        if request is not None:
            effective = run.scenario.clock_label(request.intervention().effective_tick)
        name = check.display_name or ""
        msg = (f"{name} is already confirmed." if duplicate else
               f"{name} is confirmed for the surge shift starting {effective}.")  # fmt: skip
        return ConfirmResult(
            confirmed, duplicate, reason, msg, run if changed else None, check.staff_id,
            check.display_name, check.request_id,
            request.confirmed_staff if request else None,
            request.requested_staff if request else None, effective,
        )  # fmt: skip

"""Endpoints for the FaceTime agent (agent/). Every call needs X-TriageX-Agent-Token.

GET  /api/agent/active-request   the open staffing request the caller can confirm, or 404
POST /api/agent/call             {call_id, event: connected | ended}
POST /api/agent/card-check       card fields read from live video -> roster decision
POST /api/agent/confirm          {call_id, card_id, verbal_confirmation} -> one confirmation

The backend binds to 127.0.0.1 (see docs); the token is compared in constant time.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hmac
import logging
from typing import Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.chert import _submit, publish_run
from app.config import get_settings
from app.repositories.facetime import CardCheckRow, FaceTimeCallRow
from app.services.facetime import FaceTimeService

router = APIRouter(prefix="/agent", tags=["facetime-agent"])
log = logging.getLogger("triagex.facetime.api")

TOKEN_HEADER = "X-TriageX-Agent-Token"


def require_agent_token(request: Request) -> None:
    expected = get_settings().triagex_agent_token
    if not expected:
        raise HTTPException(503, "TRIAGEX_AGENT_TOKEN is not configured on the backend")
    given = request.headers.get(TOKEN_HEADER, "")
    if not hmac.compare_digest(given.encode(), expected.encode()):
        raise HTTPException(401, "Invalid or missing agent token")


def _ft(request: Request) -> FaceTimeService:
    return request.app.state.facetime


class CallEvent(BaseModel):
    call_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    event: Literal["connected", "ended"]


class CardCheckIn(BaseModel):
    call_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    card_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    name: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    role: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    availability: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=40)
    confidence: float = Field(ge=0, le=1)


class ConfirmIn(BaseModel):
    call_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    card_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    verbal_confirmation: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)


@router.get("/active-request", dependencies=[Depends(require_agent_token)])
async def active_request(request: Request) -> dict:
    ft = _ft(request)
    run = ft.demo.active_run()
    req = ft.open_request(run)
    if req is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "No open staffing request")
    hospital = run.network.get(req.hospital_id)
    iv = req.intervention()
    return {
        "run_id": run.run_id,
        "request_id": req.request_id,
        "hospital_id": req.hospital_id,
        "hospital": hospital.short_name,
        "requested": req.requested_staff,
        "confirmed": req.confirmed_staff,
        "shift_starts": run.scenario.clock_label(iv.effective_tick),
        "expires_at": req.expires_at.isoformat(),
    }


@router.post("/call", dependencies=[Depends(require_agent_token)])
async def call_event(request: Request, body: CallEvent) -> dict:
    ft = _ft(request)
    call = ft.call_event(body.call_id, body.event)
    _submit(request.app, FaceTimeCallRow.of(call))
    run = ft.demo.touch(call.run_id) if call.run_id else None
    if run is not None:
        await publish_run(request.app, run, f"facetime_{body.event}")
    return {"call_id": call.call_id, "status": call.status}


@router.post("/card-check", dependencies=[Depends(require_agent_token)])
async def card_check(request: Request, body: CardCheckIn) -> dict:
    ft = _ft(request)
    check = ft.card_check(body.call_id, body.card_id, body.name, body.role, body.availability,
                          body.confidence)  # fmt: skip
    _submit(request.app, CardCheckRow.of(check))
    if check.run_id:
        await publish_run(request.app, ft.demo.touch(check.run_id), "facetime_card_check")
    return {
        "valid": check.valid,
        "reason": check.reason,
        "message": check.message,
        "card_id": check.card_id,
        "staff_id": check.staff_id,
        "display_name": check.display_name,
        "request_id": check.request_id,
    }


@router.post("/confirm", dependencies=[Depends(require_agent_token)])
async def confirm(request: Request, body: ConfirmIn) -> dict:
    ft = _ft(request)
    result = ft.confirm(body.call_id, body.card_id, body.verbal_confirmation)
    if result.run is not None:
        await publish_run(request.app, result.run, "staff_confirmed_facetime")
    status = 200 if result.confirmed else 409
    payload = {
        "confirmed": result.confirmed,
        "duplicate": result.duplicate,
        "reason": result.reason,
        "message": result.message,
        "staff_id": result.staff_id,
        "display_name": result.display_name,
        "confirmed_count": result.confirmed_count,
        "requested": result.requested,
        "shift_starts": result.effective_clock,
    }
    if status != 200:
        raise HTTPException(status, payload)
    return payload

"""Tiger Data rows for FaceTime calls and card checks (written by PersistenceWriter).
Text fields only: no images, no phone numbers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from app.services.facetime import CardCheck, FaceTimeCall

_CALL_SQL = """
INSERT INTO facetime_calls (call_id, run_id, status, connected_at, ended_at)
VALUES (:call_id, :run_id, :status, CAST(:connected_at AS timestamptz),
    CAST(:ended_at AS timestamptz))
ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE SET
    run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id, status = EXCLUDED.status, ended_at = EXCLUDED.ended_at
"""

_CHECK_SQL = """
INSERT INTO card_checks (
    check_id, call_id, run_id, request_id, card_id, read_name, read_role, read_availability,
    confidence, valid, reason, staff_id, checked_at)
VALUES (:check_id, :call_id, :run_id, :request_id, :card_id, :read_name, :read_role,
    :read_availability, :confidence, :valid, :reason, :staff_id, CAST(:checked_at AS timestamptz))
ON CONFLICT (check_id) DO NOTHING
"""


def _iso(v):
    return v.isoformat() if v is not None else None


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class FaceTimeCallRow:
    params: dict
    run_id: str
    version: str = "facetime_call"

    @classmethod
    def of(cls, c: FaceTimeCall) -> FaceTimeCallRow:
        return cls(
            {"call_id": c.call_id, "run_id": c.run_id, "status": c.status,
             "connected_at": _iso(c.connected_at), "ended_at": _iso(c.ended_at)},  # fmt: skip
            c.run_id or "-",
        )

    def write(self, con) -> int:
        con.run(_CALL_SQL, **self.params)
        return 1


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class CardCheckRow:
    params: dict
    run_id: str
    version: str = "card_check"

    @classmethod
    def of(cls, k: CardCheck) -> CardCheckRow:

def submit(self, snapshot: RunSnapshot) -> bool:
        """Queue a snapshot. Never blocks on the database and never raises."""
        if not self.enabled:
            return False
        with self._cond:
            if len(self._queue) >= MAX_QUEUE:
                self.status.dropped += 1
                log.error(
                    "persistence queue full; snapshot dropped",
                    extra={"run_id": snapshot.run_id, "version": snapshot.version},
                )
                return False
            self._queue.append(snapshot)
            self.status.pending = len(self._queue)
            self._cond.notify()
        return True

    def pending_for(self, run_id: str) -> int:
        with self._cond:
            return sum(1 for s in self._queue if s.run_id == run_id)

    def _run(self) -> None:
        delay = self.retry_initial_s
        statement_failures = 0
        while True:
            with self._cond:
                while not self._queue and not self._stopping and self.status.migrated:
                    self._cond.wait()
                if self._stopping:
                    return
                snapshot = self._queue[0] if self._queue else None
                self._busy = snapshot is not None
            try:
                self._ensure_ready()
                if snapshot is not None:
                    started = time.perf_counter()
                    is_event = hasattr(snapshot, "write")  # messaging rows (Phase 6)
                    with self.db.transaction() as con:
                        rows = snapshot.write(con) if is_event else write_snapshot(con, snapshot)
                    with self._cond:
                        self._queue.popleft()
                        self.status.pending = len(self._queue)
                        if is_event:
                            self.status.events_written += 1
                        else:
                            self.status.snapshots_written += 1
                        self.status.rows_written += rows
                        self.status.last_success_at = datetime.now(UTC)
                        self.status.last_write_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
                        self._busy = False
                        self._cond.notify_all()
                delay, statement_failures = self.retry_initial_s, 0
            except CONNECTION_ERRORS as exc:
                self.status.connected = False
                self._record_error(exc)
                log.warning("database unavailable; will retry", extra={"error": str(exc)})
                self._sleep(delay)

"""Prompt 4: FaceTime card checks and verbal confirmations, through the agent API."""

import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.config import get_settings
from app.main import create_app
from app.services.demo_service import DemoService

TOKEN = "test-agent-token-" + "x" * 40
H = {"X-TriageX-Agent-Token": TOKEN}
CALL = "d25d790a-410b-4695-beb0-28b86afbb9e4"


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.now = datetime(2026, 11, 14, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)

    def __call__(self) -> datetime:
        return self.now


@pytest.fixture
def clock():
    return FakeClock()


@pytest.fixture
def agent_token(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TRIAGEX_AGENT_TOKEN", TOKEN)
    get_settings.cache_clear()
    yield TOKEN
    get_settings.cache_clear()


def _app(clock, persistence=None):
    service = DemoService(request_ttl=timedelta(minutes=10), clock=clock)
    app = create_app(service, persistence=persistence)
    app.state.facetime.clock = clock
    return app


@pytest.fixture
def client(clock, agent_token):
    with TestClient(_app(clock)) as c:
        yield c


def _approved(c) -> dict:
    state = c.post("/api/demo/reset").json()
    card = next(p for p in state["proposals"] if p["recommended"])
    r = c.post(f"/api/runs/{state['run']['run_id']}/proposals/{card['id']}/approve",
               json={"at_tick": card["tick"] + 1})  # fmt: skip
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()


def _check(c, card_id="TX-RN-1001", call=CALL, **kw):
    body = {"call_id": call, "card_id": card_id, "name": "Avery (fictional RN)",
            "role": "Registered Nurse · Emergency", "availability": "AVAILABLE",
            "confidence": 0.99} | kw  # fmt: skip
    r = c.post("/api/agent/card-check", json=body, headers=H)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()


def _confirm(c, card_id="TX-RN-1001", call=CALL, verbal="I confirm"):
    return c.post("/api/agent/confirm", headers=H,
                  json={"call_id": call, "card_id": card_id, "verbal_confirmation": verbal})  # fmt: skip


def _state(c) -> dict:
    return c.get("/api/demo/state").json()


def test_requires_the_agent_token(client):
    _approved(client)
    assert client.get("/api/agent/active-request").status_code == 401
    assert client.get("/api/agent/active-request",
                      headers={"X-TriageX-Agent-Token": "wrong"}).status_code == 401  # fmt: skip
    body = {"call_id": CALL, "card_id": "TX-RN-1001", "confidence": 1}
    assert client.post("/api/agent/card-check", json=body).status_code == 401
    assert client.get("/api/integrations/health").json()["facetime"]["status"] == "starting"
    assert client.get("/api/agent/active-request", headers=H).status_code == 200
    assert client.get("/api/integrations/health").json()["facetime"]["status"] == "ok"


def test_without_a_configured_token_every_agent_call_is_refused(clock):
    get_settings.cache_clear()
    with TestClient(_app(clock)) as c:
        assert c.get("/api/agent/active-request", headers=H).status_code == 503
        assert c.get("/api/integrations/health").json()["facetime"]["status"] == "not_configured"


def test_active_request(client):
    assert client.get("/api/agent/active-request", headers=H).status_code == 404
    _approved(client)
    r = client.get("/api/agent/active-request", headers=H).json()
    assert (r["hospital"], r["requested"], r["confirmed"]) == ("Grady", 3, 0)
    assert r["shift_starts"] == "17:15"


def test_valid_card_and_verbal_confirmation_confirm_exactly_once(client):
    before = _approved(client)
    baseline_before = before["impact"]["primary"]["baseline"]
    assert client.post("/api/agent/call", headers=H,
                       json={"call_id": CALL, "event": "connected"}).status_code == 200  # fmt: skip
    check = _check(client)
    assert check["valid"] and check["reason"] == "valid"
    assert (check["staff_id"], check["display_name"]) == ("rn-avery", "Avery (fictional RN)")
    assert _state(client)["staffing_requests"][0]["confirmed_staff"] == 0  # a check confirms nothing

    r = _confirm(client)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["confirmed"] and not body["duplicate"]
    assert (body["confirmed_count"], body["requested"], body["shift_starts"]) == (1, 3, "17:15")
    for _ in range(3):  # retries and repeats add nothing
        again = _confirm(client)
        assert again.status_code == 200 and again.json()["duplicate"]

    state = _state(client)
    req = state["staffing_requests"][0]
    assert req["confirmed_staff"] == 1
    assert req["confirmations"][0]["source"] == "facetime"
    assert req["effective_tick"] == req["approved_tick"] + 3
    assert state["impact"]["primary"]["baseline"] == baseline_before  # the baseline never changes
    titles = [e["title"] for e in state["feed"] if e["origin"] == "facetime"]
    assert titles == ["FaceTime Connected", "Card Verified", "Staff Confirmed via FaceTime"]
    call = state["facetime"]["calls"][0]
    assert call["checks"][0]["card_id"] == "TX-RN-1001" and call["confirmed_staff"] == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("card_id", "fields", "reason"),
    [
        ("TX-RN-9999", {"name": "Sam (fictional RN)"}, "not_on_roster"),
        ("TX-RN-1004", {"name": "Riley (fictional RN)", "availability": "OFF DUTY"}, "off_duty"),
        ("TX-RN-1001", {"confidence": 0.5}, "low_confidence"),

)

    check = _check(client, card_id, **fields)

    r = _confirm(client, card_id)
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["detail"]["reason"] == reason
    after = _state(client)

    _approved(client)

    _approved(client)

def test_check_older_than_two_minutes_is_not_enough(client, clock):
    _approved(client)

    assert _confirm(client).json()["detail"]["reason"] == "no_prior_check"

    _approved(client)

def test_stale_run_after_reset(client):
    _approved(client)

    _approved(client)

    _approved(client)

"""Chert iMessage API: outbound sends, credential checks, and inbound webhook verification.
Verified against docs.trychert.com on 2026-11-14 (pages: api/quickstart, api/authentication,
api/receiving-replies, api/webhook-subscriptions, api/errors):
- Send: POST {base}/send with JSON {"phone": "+1...", "body": "..."}. Success returns
  {"status": "sent", "message_id", "lead_id", ...}; lead_id is the chat id that inbound
  events carry as data.chat.id. Failures return {"status": "failed", "code", "retryable",
  "reason" | "message"}.
- Request auth: x-chert-signature "v1,<unix_seconds>,<hex>" (HMAC-SHA256 of "<ts>." + raw
  body with the signing secret) plus x-chert-tenant; or Authorization: Bearer <secret>.
- Identity: GET {base}/whoami confirms the tenant (response shape not documented, so only
  the HTTP status is trusted).
- Webhooks: X-Webhook-Signature "t=<ts>,v1=<hex>" (legacy x-chert-signature "v1,<ts>,<hex>"),
  HMAC-SHA256 of "<ts>." + raw body with the *subscription* secret, 300 s tolerance,
  at-least-once delivery deduplicated on event_id, 5xx retried (3 attempts), 4xx not.
- Inbound message.received: data.chat.id, data.message.{id, direction, sender_handle.handle,
  sender_handle.is_me, parts[{type: "text", value}]}.

import hashlib
import hmac

from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

DEFAULT_API_BASE = "https://console.trychert.com/api/v1"

_E164 = re.compile(r"^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$")
_MODERN_SIG = re.compile(r"^t=(\d+),v1=([a-f0-9]+)$")
_LEGACY_SIG = re.compile(r"^v1,(\d+),([a-f0-9]+)$")
# --- phone numbers -------------------------------------------------------------------------
def normalize_phone(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    """Return an E.164 number, or None. Only explicit '+<country><number>' is accepted, so a

class SignatureError(ValueError):
    pass
def _hmac_hex(secret: str, ts: int | str, raw_body: bytes) -> str:
    return hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{ts}.".encode() + raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
def sign_webhook(raw_body: bytes, secret: str, ts: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Build an X-Webhook-Signature value exactly as Chert does (used by tests and fixtures)."""
    ts = int(time.time()) if ts is None else ts
    return f"t={ts},v1={_hmac_hex(secret, ts, raw_body)}"
def verify_webhook_signature(
    raw_body: bytes, headers: Mapping[str, str], secret: str, now: float | None = None
) -> int:
    """Verify a webhook delivery against the raw body. Returns the signed timestamp.
    Accepts the recommended X-Webhook-Signature header and the legacy x-chert-signature
    header. Raises SignatureError on anything else."""
    if not secret:
        raise SignatureError("webhook secret not configured")
    lowered = {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()}
    match = None
    if modern := lowered.get("x-webhook-signature"):
        match = _MODERN_SIG.match(modern.strip())
    elif legacy := lowered.get("x-chert-signature"):
        match = _LEGACY_SIG.match(legacy.strip())
    else:
        raise SignatureError("missing signature header")
    if match is None:
        raise SignatureError("malformed signature header")
    ts, received = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2)
    now = time.time() if now is None else now
    if abs(now - ts) > SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_S:
        raise SignatureError("signature timestamp outside the 300 s tolerance")
    if not hmac.compare_digest(received, _hmac_hex(secret, ts, raw_body)):
        raise SignatureError("signature mismatch")
    return ts

@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class InboundEvent:
    event_id: str
    event_type: str
    chat_id: str | None
    message_id: str | None
    direction: str | None
    sender: str | None  # phone (E.164) or Apple ID email, as Chert reports it
    is_me: bool
    text: str
def parse_event(payload: Mapping) -> InboundEvent:
    """Extract the fields TriageX uses. Raises ValueError if the envelope is unusable."""
    event_id = payload.get("event_id")
    event_type = payload.get("event_type")
    if not isinstance(event_id, str) or not event_id or not isinstance(event_type, str):
        raise ValueError("event_id and event_type are required")
    def obj(parent: Mapping, key: str) -> Mapping:
        value = parent.get(key)
        return value if isinstance(value, Mapping) else {}
    data = obj(payload, "data")
    chat, message = obj(data, "chat"), obj(data, "message")
    sender = obj(message, "sender_handle")
    parts = message.get("parts") if isinstance(message.get("parts"), list) else []
    text = " ".join(
        str(p.get("value", ""))
        for p in parts
        if isinstance(p, Mapping) and p.get("type") == "text"
    )
    return InboundEvent(
        event_id=event_id,
        event_type=event_type,
        chat_id=chat.get("id") if isinstance(chat.get("id"), str) else None,
        message_id=message.get("id") if isinstance(message.get("id"), str) else None,
        direction=message.get("direction") if isinstance(message.get("direction"), str) else None,
        sender=sender.get("handle") if isinstance(sender.get("handle"), str) else None,
        is_me=bool(sender.get("is_me", False)),
        text=text,
    )

        reason = data.get("reason") or data.get("message") or data.get("error") or resp.text[:200]
        code = data.get("code")
        return SendResult(False, resp.status_code,
                          error=f"HTTP {resp.status_code}" + (f" code {code}" if code else "")

                          latency_ms=_ms(started))  # fmt: skip

    def create_subscription(self, url: str) -> tuple[int, dict]:
        """POST /webhook-subscriptions for message.received. The response carries
        subscription.secret exactly once."""
        resp = self._request("POST", "/webhook-subscriptions",
                             {"url": url, "events": ["message.received"]})  # fmt: skip
        return resp.status_code, _json(resp)

    def check(self) -> CheckResult:
        """Credential check: GET /whoami, then list webhook subscriptions."""
        try:
            who = self._request("GET", "/whoami")
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            return CheckResult(False, None, f"Chert unreachable: {type(exc).__name__}")
        if who.status_code >= 300:
            return CheckResult(False, who.status_code, f"whoami rejected: HTTP {who.status_code}")
        subs: list[dict] = []
        try:
            resp = self._request("GET", "/webhook-subscriptions")
            if resp.status_code < 300:
                raw = _json(resp).get("subscriptions")
                subs = [s for s in raw if isinstance(s, dict)] if isinstance(raw, list) else []
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            pass
        return CheckResult(True, who.status_code, "whoami accepted the credentials", subs)

    # --- shared line: inbound by polling ----------------------------------------------------
    def _shared_event(self, m: SharedMessage) -> InboundEvent:
        return InboundEvent(
            event_id=f"shared:{m.message_id}", event_type="message.received", chat_id=None,
            message_id=m.message_id,
            direction=None if m.inbound is None else ("inbound" if m.inbound else "outbound"),
            sender=m.peer, is_me=m.inbound is False, text=m.text, created_at=m.created_at,
        )  # fmt: skip

    def prime_shared(self) -> int:
        """Before sending: mark every message already on the line as seen, so an old "IN"
        can never confirm a new request. Returns how many were marked."""
        if not self.shared:
            return 0
        result = self.client.list_messages()
        if not result.ok:
            return 0
        with self._lock:
            for m in result.messages:
                self._seen.setdefault(f"shared:{m.message_id}", ("baseline", None))
            self.last_poll_fields = result.field_names
        return len(result.messages)

    def awaiting_shared(self) -> bool:
        """True while a sent shared-line message waits for a reply on the active run."""
        if not self.shared:
            return False
        run = self.demo.active_run()
        with self._lock:
            records = [r for r in self._records.values()
                       if r.channel == "shared" and r.run_id == run.run_id and r.status == "sent"]  # fmt: skip
        for r in records:
            req = run.staffing_requests.get(r.request_id)
            if req is not None and self.demo.request_status(req) in (
                "awaiting_replies", "partially_confirmed"
            ):
                return True
        return False

    def poll_shared(self) -> list[WebhookOutcome]:
        """One poll of GET /shared-messages. Each new message is processed once (deduplicated
        on Chert's message id) through the same rules as a webhook delivery."""
        if not self.shared:
            return []
        result = self.client.list_messages()
        self.last_poll_at = self.clock()
        if not result.ok:
            log.warning("shared-messages poll failed", extra={"error": result.error})
            return []
        self.last_poll_fields, self.poll_unparsed = result.field_names, result.unparsed
        outcomes = []
        # Oldest first, so replies are handled in the order they were sent.
        ordered = sorted(result.messages, key=lambda m: m.created_at or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=UTC))
        for m in ordered:
            key = f"shared:{m.message_id}"
            with self._lock:
                if key in self._seen:
                    continue
                if m.inbound is False:
                    self._seen[key] = ("ignored_outbound", None)
                    continue
                started = time.perf_counter()
                event = self._shared_event(m)
                outcome = self._process(event)
                outcome.processing_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
                self._seen[key] = (outcome.outcome, outcome.record)
                while len(self._seen) > SEEN_EVENTS_MAX:
                    self._seen.popitem(last=False)
                self.counters[outcome.outcome] = self.counters.get(outcome.outcome, 0) + 1
                self.last_webhook = outcome
            log.info("shared reply", extra={"outcome": outcome.outcome, "message_id": m.message_id})
            outcomes.append(outcome)
        return outcomes

"""Prompt 5: Chert Shared-line iMessage adapter (app.trychert.com project API), with
httpx.MockTransport fixtures. The response shapes are NOT documented by Chert; these
fixtures use one plausible shape and the parser tests cover the others it accepts."""

import json
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import httpx
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import app.api.chert as chert_api
from app.integrations.chert_shared import SharedLineClient, parse_list
from app.main import create_app
from app.services.demo_service import DemoService
from app.services.outreach import ChertConfig, OutreachService

KEY = "ftk_test_only"
PROJECT = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
LINE = "99999999-8888-7777-6666-555555555555"
PHONE_A = "+15555550101"
PHONE_B = "+15555550102"
STRANGER = "+15555550199"


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.now = datetime(2026, 11, 14, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)

    def __call__(self) -> datetime:
        return self.now


class FakeShared:
    """Stands in for app.trychert.com/api/v1/shared-messages."""

    def __init__(self, *, fail_sends=False, list_status=200):
        self.messages: list[dict] = []
        self.requests: list[httpx.Request] = []
        self.sent: list[dict] = []
        self.fail_sends = fail_sends
        self.list_status = list_status
        self._n = 0

    def add(self, sender, text, at, direction="inbound"):
        self._n += 1
        self.messages.append({"id": f"msg-{self._n}", "direction": direction, "from": sender,
                              "text": text, "created_at": at.isoformat()})  # fmt: skip

    def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self.requests.append(request)
        if request.url.path.endswith("/shared-messages") and request.method == "POST":
            body = json.loads(request.content)
            self.sent.append(body)
            if self.fail_sends:
                return httpx.Response(403, json={"error": {"message": "recipient not verified"}})
            self._n += 1
            self.messages.append({"id": f"msg-{self._n}", "direction": "outbound",
                                  "to": body["recipient"], "text": body["text"],
                                  "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()})  # fmt: skip
            return httpx.Response(201, json={"id": f"msg-{self._n}", "status": "queued"})
        if request.url.path.endswith("/shared-messages"):
            if self.list_status != 200:
                return httpx.Response(self.list_status, json={"error": "unauthorized"})
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"messages": list(reversed(self.messages[-50:]))})
        return httpx.Response(404, json={})


def make(clock, fake, phones=(PHONE_A, PHONE_B)):
    demo = DemoService(request_ttl=timedelta(minutes=10), clock=clock)
    config = ChertConfig(api_key=KEY, project_id=PROJECT, line_id=LINE, allowed_phones=phones)
    client = SharedLineClient(KEY, PROJECT, LINE, "https://chert.test/api/v1",
                              transport=httpx.MockTransport(fake.handler))  # fmt: skip
    return OutreachService(demo, config, client, clock=clock)


@pytest.fixture
def clock():
    return FakeClock()


@pytest.fixture
def fake():
    return FakeShared()


@pytest.fixture
def live(clock, fake, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(chert_api, "SHARED_POLL_S", 0.05)
    outreach = make(clock, fake)
    with TestClient(create_app(outreach=outreach)) as c:
        c.outreach, c.fake, c.clock = outreach, fake, clock
        yield c


def approve_and_send(c) -> dict:
    state = c.post("/api/demo/reset").json()
    card = next(p for p in state["proposals"] if p["recommended"])
    c.post(f"/api/runs/{state['run']['run_id']}/proposals/{card['id']}/approve",
           json={"at_tick": 18})  # fmt: skip
    return wait(c, lambda s: len(s["staffing_requests"][0]["outreach"]) == 2 and all(
        o["status"] != "sending" for o in s["staffing_requests"][0]["outreach"]))  # fmt: skip


def wait(c, predicate, timeout=5.0) -> dict:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        state = c.get("/api/demo/state").json()
        if predicate(state):
            return state
        time.sleep(0.03)
    raise AssertionError("condition not reached")


def confs(state):
    return state["staffing_requests"][0]["confirmations"]


def test_send_uses_the_documented_request(live):
    approve_and_send(live)
    posts = [r for r in live.fake.requests if r.method == "POST"]
    assert len(posts) == 2
    for r in posts:
        assert r.headers["authorization"] == f"Bearer {KEY}"
        assert r.headers["x-chert-project-id"] == PROJECT
        assert 8 <= len(r.headers["idempotency-key"]) <= 200
    keys = {r.headers["idempotency-key"] for r in posts}
    assert len(keys) == 2  # one key per outreach message
    for body in live.fake.sent:
        assert body["line_id"] == LINE and body["recipient"] in (PHONE_A, PHONE_B)
        assert body["text"].startswith("TriageX DEMO")
        assert "Reply IN within 10 minutes" in body["text"]


def test_in_reply_confirms_once_as_live_imessage(live):
    approve_and_send(live)
    live.fake.add(PHONE_A, " in ", live.clock.now + timedelta(seconds=20))
    state = wait(live, lambda s: len(confs(s)) == 1)
    assert confs(state)[0]["source"] == "imessage"
    assert any(e["title"] == "Staff Confirmed" and "live iMessage" in e["detail"]
               for e in state["feed"])  # fmt: skip
    time.sleep(0.3)  # the same message is returned by every later poll: still one
    assert len(confs(live.get("/api/demo/state").json())) == 1


def test_messages_from_before_our_send_never_confirm(live):
    # An old "IN" already on the line (baseline), and one dated before our message.
    live.fake.add(PHONE_A, "IN", live.clock.now - timedelta(hours=1))
    approve_and_send(live)
    live.fake.add(PHONE_B, "IN", live.clock.now - timedelta(minutes=1))
    time.sleep(0.4)
    assert confs(live.get("/api/demo/state").json()) == []
    assert live.outreach.counters["stale_request"] == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("sender", "text", "outcome"),
    [(STRANGER, "IN", "unknown_sender"), (PHONE_A, "maybe", "not_confirmation_text"),
     (PHONE_A, "IN please", "not_confirmation_text")],
)  # fmt: skip
def test_unknown_senders_and_other_text_change_nothing(live, sender, text, outcome):
    approve_and_send(live)
    live.fake.add(sender, text, live.clock.now + timedelta(seconds=5))
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
    while live.outreach.counters[outcome] == 0 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.03)
    assert live.outreach.counters[outcome] == 1
    assert confs(live.get("/api/demo/state").json()) == []


def test_reply_after_expiry_changes_nothing(live):
    approve_and_send(live)
    live.clock.now += timedelta(minutes=10, seconds=1)
    live.fake.add(PHONE_A, "IN", live.clock.now)
    # The request expired, so polling stops; a manual poll shows the rejection.
    outcomes = live.outreach.poll_shared()
    assert [o.outcome for o in outcomes] == ["rejected_request"]
    assert confs(live.get("/api/demo/state").json()) == []


def test_reply_to_a_previous_run_is_stale(live):
    approve_and_send(live)
    live.post("/api/demo/reset")
    live.fake.add(PHONE_A, "IN", live.clock.now + timedelta(seconds=5))
    assert [o.outcome for o in live.outreach.poll_shared()] == ["stale_request"]


def test_failed_send_is_reported_and_cannot_be_confirmed(clock, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(chert_api, "SHARED_POLL_S", 0.05)
    fake = FakeShared(fail_sends=True)
    with TestClient(create_app(outreach=make(clock, fake))) as c:
        state = approve_and_send(c)
        out = state["staffing_requests"][0]["outreach"]
        assert {o["status"] for o in out} == {"failed"}
        assert "HTTP 403" in out[0]["error"]
        fake.add(PHONE_A, "IN", clock.now + timedelta(seconds=5))
        time.sleep(0.3)
        assert confs(c.get("/api/demo/state").json()) == []


def test_health_is_ok_only_after_a_real_authenticated_get(clock):
    good = make(clock, FakeShared())
    assert good.health()[0] == "starting"
    good.check_connection()
    status, detail = good.health()
    assert status == "ok" and "GET /shared-messages accepted" in detail
    bad = make(clock, FakeShared(list_status=401))
    bad.check_connection()
    assert bad.health()[0] == "error"
    missing = OutreachService(DemoService(clock=clock), ChertConfig(api_key=REDACTED, clock=clock)
    status, detail = missing.health()
    assert status == "not_configured" and "CHERT_PROJECT_ID" in detail and "CHERT_LINE_ID" in detail


def test_parser_accepts_other_plausible_shapes():
    at = "2026-11-14T12:00:30Z"
    shapes = [
        [{"id": "a", "direction": "inbound", "sender": PHONE_A, "text": "IN", "created_at": at}],
        {"data": [{"message_id": "a", "is_from_me": False, "handle": {"handle": PHONE_A},
                   "body": "IN", "timestamp": 1794657630}]},
        {"items": [{"uuid": "a", "direction": "received", "from_phone": "+1 555 555 0101",
                    "content": "IN", "date": at}]},
    ]  # fmt: skip
    for shape in shapes:
        messages, unparsed, names = parse_list(shape)
        assert unparsed == 0 and names
        m = messages[0]
        assert (m.message_id, m.inbound, m.peer, m.text) == ("a", True, PHONE_A, "IN")
        assert m.created_at is not None and m.created_at.tzinfo is not None
    assert parse_list({"weird": 1}) == ([], 0, [])
    _, unparsed, _ = parse_list([{"no_id": True}, "x"])
    assert unparsed == 2


def test_console_api_settings_still_select_the_console_client(clock):
    svc = OutreachService(DemoService(clock=clock), ChertConfig(signing_secret="REDACTED", allowed_phones=(PHONE_A,)), clock=clock)  # noqa: E501
    assert not svc.shared and svc.client is not None

def test_shared_line_events_are_persisted_without_phone_numbers(database, clock, monkeypatch):
    from app.repositories.persistence import PersistenceWriter

    monkeypatch.setattr(chert_api, "SHARED_POLL_S", 0.05)
    writer = PersistenceWriter(database, retry_initial_s=0.05, retry_max_s=0.2)
    fake = FakeShared()
    with TestClient(create_app(outreach=make(clock, fake), persistence=writer)) as c:
        writer.start()
        approve_and_send(c)
        fake.add(PHONE_A, "IN", clock.now + timedelta(seconds=10))
        fake.add(STRANGER, "IN", clock.now + timedelta(seconds=11))
        wait(c, lambda s: len(confs(s)) == 1)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
        while c.outreach.counters["unknown_sender"] == 0 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.03)
        assert writer.flush(15), writer.status.last_error
        assert writer.status.dead_letters == []

        def rows(sql):
            with database.connection() as con:
                return con.run(sql)

        assert sorted(map(tuple, rows("SELECT channel, status FROM outreach_events"))) == [
            ("shared", "confirmed"), ("shared", "sent")]  # fmt: skip
        hooks = sorted(map(tuple, rows("SELECT channel, outcome, signature_valid FROM webhook_events")))
        assert hooks == [("shared_poll", "confirmed", False), ("shared_poll", "unknown_sender", False)]

        dump = json.dumps(rows("SELECT row_to_json(o)::text FROM outreach_events o")
                          + rows("SELECT row_to_json(w)::text FROM webhook_events w"))  # fmt: skip
        assert PHONE_A not in dump and STRANGER not in dump
    writer.stop()

"""Read-only check of the Chert hackathon (Shared/trial) line API. Prints no secrets, no phone
numbers and no message text: only HTTP statuses, line ids/names, field NAMES and counts.

Reads CHERT_API_KEY and CHERT_PROJECT_ID (and CHERT_LINE_ID, if set) from the repo's .env.

    cd backend
    uv run python ../scripts/chert_inspect.py

1. GET /api/v1/lines            -> your line ids (put the right one in CHERT_LINE_ID)
2. GET /api/v1/shared-messages  -> the real response shape (field names), which Chert does not
                                   document; compare it with app/integrations/chert_shared.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "backend"))

import httpx  # noqa: E402

from app.config import get_settings  # noqa: E402
from app.integrations.chert_shared import DEFAULT_SHARED_API_BASE, parse_list  # noqa: E402


def _shape(value, depth=0) -> str:
    """Field names and value types only (never values)."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        inner = ", ".join(f"{k}: {_shape(v, depth + 1)}" for k, v in value.items()) if depth < 2 else "…"
        return "{" + inner + "}"
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return f"list[{len(value)}]" + (f" of {_shape(value[0], depth + 1)}" if value else "")
    return type(value).__name__


def main() -> int:
    s = get_settings()
    if not (s.chert_api_key and s.chert_project_id):
        print("Set CHERT_API_KEY and CHERT_PROJECT_ID in .env first (never paste them in chat).")
        return 2
    base = (s.chert_shared_api_base or DEFAULT_SHARED_API_BASE).rstrip("/")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {s.chert_api_key}", "X-Chert-Project-Id": s.chert_project_id}
    with httpx.Client(base_url=base, headers=headers, timeout=10) as c:
        r = c.get("/lines")
        print(f"GET /lines -> HTTP {r.status_code}")
        if r.status_code < 300:
            data = r.json()
            items = data if isinstance(data, list) else next(
                (v for v in data.values() if isinstance(v, list)), []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
            print(f"  shape: {_shape(data)}")
            for line in items:
                if isinstance(line, dict):
                    mark = "  <- CHERT_LINE_ID" if line.get("id") == s.chert_line_id else ""
                    print(f"  line id={line.get('id')} name={line.get('name') or line.get('display_name')}{mark}")
        r = c.get("/shared-messages")
        print(f"GET /shared-messages -> HTTP {r.status_code}")
        if r.status_code < 300:
            data = r.json()
            print(f"  shape: {_shape(data)}")
            messages, unparsed, names = parse_list(data)
            print(f"  field names: {names}")
            directions = {"inbound": 0, "outbound": 0, "unknown": 0}
            for m in messages:
                directions["unknown" if m.inbound is None else ("inbound" if m.inbound else "outbound")] += 1
            print(f"  parsed {len(messages)} messages ({directions}), unparsed {unparsed}; "
                  f"with a phone: {sum(1 for m in messages if m.peer)}; "
                  f"with a timestamp: {sum(1 for m in messages if m.created_at)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Grounded operational brief (handoff Prompt 6, docs/plan.md Section F).

Every number in a brief comes from the dashboard state the API already serves
(build_dashboard), as it is visible at the requested playhead tick: nothing after the playhead
is included (spoiler rule), and the demo-window result only once the playhead reaches the end
of the window.

Grounding: the model never writes a number. It receives a facts JSON (metric_key -> value and
label) and writes text with {metric_key} placeholders; the server substitutes the values.
Any digit left in the model's text, or a placeholder that is not a fact, rejects the output.

Providers (Gemini API free tier, the same key as the FaceTime agent; no paid provider):
primary GEMINI_MODEL (default gemini-3.1-flash-lite), fallback GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL (default
gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Per-minute quotas are per model, so neither competes with the agent's
card reader. Fallback on timeout (8 s), 429, 5xx, connection errors, or invalid structure after
one retry; auth/config errors are reported as "primary misconfigured". If both fail, a
deterministic template brief labeled "AI unavailable" is returned. Fallback is never silent.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import re
import threading
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Protocol

import httpx

from app.models.dashboard import DashboardState

log = logging.getLogger("triagex.brief")

GEMINI_API = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models"
DEFAULT_PRIMARY_MODEL = "gemini-3.1-flash-lite"
DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MODEL = "gemini-3.5-flash-lite"
TIMEOUT_S = 8.0
PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\{([a-z_]+)\}")

BRIEF_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "headline": {"type": "string", "description": "One sentence. Numbers only as {metric_key}."},
        "bullets": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {"type": "string"},
            "minItems": 2,
            "maxItems": 4,
            "description": "Short situation bullets. Numbers only as {metric_key}.",
        },
        "action": {"type": "string", "description": "The next operator action, one sentence."},
    },
    "required": ["headline", "bullets", "action"],
    "additionalProperties": False,
}

SYSTEM = """You write a short operational brief for an emergency-department surge command center.
This is a hackathon demo: all data is synthetic and the hospitals are a simulation.
Use ONLY the facts provided. Never write a digit. Every number, time or percentage must be written
as its placeholder in braces, exactly as the fact key, e.g. {focus_saturation_pct}. Do not invent
facts, causes, names or outcomes that are not in the facts. Do not predict results that are not in
the facts. Be calm and concrete. Headline: one sentence. Bullets: two to four short sentences.
Action: one sentence on what the operator should do next."""


# --- facts -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class Fact:
    value: str
    label: str


def _pct(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:.0f}%"


def build_facts(state: DashboardState, at_tick: int) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Fact]]:
    """Facts visible at `at_tick` (clamped to the demo window). Returns (tick, facts)."""
    w = state.curves.window
    t = max(w.start_tick, min(at_tick, w.end_tick - 1))
    last = w.end_tick - 1
    clocks = state.timeline.clocks
    focus_id = state.curves.focus_hospital_id
    focus = next(h for h in state.hospitals if h.id == focus_id)
    diverged = state.divergence is not None and t >= state.divergence.tick
    facts: dict[str, Fact] = {
        "clock": Fact(clocks[t], "simulated time now"),
        "focus_hospital": Fact(focus.short_name, "hospital under surge"),
    }

    def point(hid: str, track: str):
        series = next(s for s in state.series if s.hospital_id == hid)
        return getattr(series, track)[t]

    p = point(focus_id, "triagex" if diverged else "baseline")
    facts |= {
        "focus_saturation_pct": Fact(_pct(p.saturation_pct), f"{focus.short_name} occupancy now"),
        "focus_forecast_pct": Fact(
            _pct(p.forecast_saturation_pct), f"{focus.short_name} 2-hour forecast occupancy"
        ),
        "focus_patients_waiting": Fact(str(p.queue_length), "patients waiting to be seen"),
        "focus_ambulances_waiting": Fact(str(p.ambulances_waiting), "ambulances waiting to offload"),
        "focus_staff_on_duty": Fact(str(p.staff_on_duty), "staff on duty"),
    }
    track = "triagex" if diverged else "baseline"
    breach = sum(1 for h in state.hospitals if point(h.id, track).status == "breach")
    facts["hospitals_in_breach"] = Fact(str(breach), "hospitals over capacity now")
    facts["hospitals_total"] = Fact(str(len(state.hospitals)), "hospitals in the network")

    surge = state.run.scenario.surge_onset_tick
    if t >= surge:
        facts["surge_name"] = Fact(state.run.scenario.name, "scenario")
        facts["surge_start"] = Fact(clocks[surge], "surge start time")
    card = next((c for c in state.proposals if c.recommended), None)
    if card is not None and t >= card.tick:
        facts["proposal_staff"] = Fact(str(card.recommended_staff or 0), "staff TriageX proposes")
        facts["proposal_time"] = Fact(card.clock, "time the proposal was made")
    req = next((r for r in state.staffing_requests if r.approved_tick <= t), None)
    if req is not None:
        facts |= {
            "request_approved_at": Fact(req.approved_clock, "time the operator approved outreach"),
            "staff_requested": Fact(str(req.requested_staff), "staff requested"),
            "staff_confirmed": Fact(str(req.confirmed_staff), "staff confirmed"),
            "shift_start": Fact(req.effective_clock, "confirmed staff on the floor from"),
        }
        live = sum(1 for c in req.confirmations if c.source in ("facetime", "imessage", "webhook"))
        facts["staff_confirmed_live"] = Fact(str(live), "confirmations from live channels")
        facts["staff_confirmed_simulated"] = Fact(
            str(req.confirmed_staff - live), "confirmations from the labeled simulated fallback"
        )
    if diverged:
        cp = next(c for c in state.curves.points if c.tick == t)
        facts |= {
            "amb_hours_lost_without": Fact(
                f"{cp.baseline_ambulance_hours_cumulative:.2f} h",
                "ambulance-hours lost so far without TriageX",
            ),
            "amb_hours_lost_with": Fact(
                f"{cp.triagex_ambulance_hours_cumulative:.2f} h",
                "ambulance-hours lost so far with TriageX",
            ),
            "amb_hours_saved_so_far": Fact(
                f"{cp.ambulance_hours_saved_so_far:.2f} h", "ambulance-hours saved so far"
            ),
        }
    if t >= last and state.divergence is not None:  # the demo-window result, only at the end
        m = state.impact.primary
        facts |= {
            "result_lost_without": Fact(f"{m.baseline:.2f} h", f"{m.label} without TriageX"),
            "result_lost_with": Fact(f"{m.triagex:.2f} h", f"{m.label} with TriageX"),
            "result_saved": Fact(f"{abs(m.delta):.2f} h", f"{m.label} saved"),
        }
        if m.pct_change is not None:
            facts["result_pct"] = Fact(f"{abs(m.pct_change):.0f}%", "relative reduction")
        if state.impact.recovery.minutes_sooner:
            facts["recovery_minutes_sooner"] = Fact(
                f"{state.impact.recovery.minutes_sooner} min", "recovered sooner with TriageX"
            )
    return t, facts


# --- validation and rendering --------------------------------------------------------------
class InvalidBrief(ValueError):
    pass


def render(raw: dict, facts: dict[str, Fact]) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """Validate the model's structure and grounding, then substitute the fact values."""
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise InvalidBrief("not an object")
    headline, bullets, action = raw.get("headline"), raw.get("bullets"), raw.get("action")
    if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(action, str) or not isinstance(bullets, list):
        raise InvalidBrief("missing headline, bullets or action")
    if not 1 <= len(bullets) <= 4 or not all(isinstance(b, str) and b.strip() for b in bullets):
        raise InvalidBrief("bullets must be 1 to 4 non-empty strings")
    cited: list[str] = []

    def one(text: str) -> str:
        keys = PLACEHOLDER.findall(text)
        unknown = [k for k in keys if k not in facts]
        if unknown:
            raise InvalidBrief(f"unknown metric_key {unknown[0]!r}")
        if re.search(r"\d", PLACEHOLDER.sub("", text)):
            raise InvalidBrief("a number was written without a placeholder")
        if "{" in PLACEHOLDER.sub("", text) or "}" in PLACEHOLDER.sub("", text):
            raise InvalidBrief("malformed placeholder")
        for k in keys:
            if k not in cited:
                cited.append(k)
        return PLACEHOLDER.sub(lambda m: facts[m.group(1)].value, text).strip()

    out = {
        "headline": one(headline),
        "bullets": [one(b) for b in bullets],
        "action": one(action),
    }
    return out, cited


def template(facts: dict[str, Fact]) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """Deterministic brief from the same facts (used when every AI provider failed)."""
    f = {k: v.value for k, v in facts.items()}
    bullets = [f"{f['focus_hospital']} at {f['focus_saturation_pct']} occupancy; "
               f"2-hour forecast {f['focus_forecast_pct']}."]  # fmt: skip
    bullets.append(f"{f['hospitals_in_breach']} of {f['hospitals_total']} hospitals over capacity; "
                   f"{f['focus_ambulances_waiting']} ambulances waiting at {f['focus_hospital']}.")  # fmt: skip
    if "staff_requested" in f:
        bullets.append(f"Outreach approved at {f['request_approved_at']}: {f['staff_confirmed']} of "
                       f"{f['staff_requested']} staff confirmed; shift starts {f['shift_start']}.")  # fmt: skip
    if "result_saved" in f:
        bullets.append(f"Result: {f['result_saved']} of ambulance time saved "
                       f"({f['result_lost_without']} → {f['result_lost_with']}).")  # fmt: skip
    elif "amb_hours_saved_so_far" in f:
        bullets.append(f"{f['amb_hours_saved_so_far']} of ambulance time saved so far.")
    if "staff_requested" not in f and "proposal_staff" in f:
        action = f"Approve outreach for {f['proposal_staff']} staff at {f['focus_hospital']}."
    elif "staff_requested" in f and f["staff_confirmed"] != f["staff_requested"]:
        action = "Collect the remaining staff confirmations."
    else:
        action = f"Keep monitoring {f['focus_hospital']}."
    headline = f"{f['clock']}: {f['focus_hospital']} at {f['focus_saturation_pct']} occupancy."
    used = [k for k in facts if any(facts[k].value in s for s in (headline, action, *bullets))]
    return {"headline": headline, "bullets": bullets[:4], "action": action}, used


# --- providers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ProviderError(Exception):
    """kind: timeout | rate_limited | server | connection | invalid | auth | config"""

    def __init__(self, kind: str, detail: str = ""):
        super().__init__(f"{kind}: {detail}" if detail else kind)
        self.kind = kind
        self.detail = detail


FALLBACK_KINDS = {"timeout", "rate_limited", "server", "connection", "invalid", "auth", "config"}
MISCONFIGURED = {"auth", "config"}


class AIProvider(Protocol):
    name: str
    model: str

    def generate(self, system: str, facts: dict, schema: dict) -> dict: ...


class GeminiProvider:
    name = "gemini"

    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None,
                 timeout_s: float = TIMEOUT_S):  # fmt: skip
        self.model = model
        self._client = httpx.Client(timeout=timeout_s, transport=transport,
                                    headers={"x-goog-api-key": api_key})  # fmt: skip

    def generate(self, system: str, facts: dict, schema: dict) -> dict:
        body = {
            "systemInstruction": {"parts": [{"text": system}]},
            "contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": "Facts JSON:\n" + json.dumps(facts)}]}],
            # No temperature override: Gemini 3 models were measured to stall at temperature 0.
            "generationConfig": {"responseMimeType": "application/json",
                                 "responseJsonSchema": schema, "maxOutputTokens": 800},
        }  # fmt: skip
        try:
            resp = self._client.post(f"{GEMINI_API}/{self.model}:generateContent", json=body)
        except httpx.TimeoutException as exc:
            raise ProviderError("timeout", type(exc).__name__) from exc
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise ProviderError("connection", type(exc).__name__) from exc
        if resp.status_code == 429:
            raise ProviderError("rate_limited", "HTTP 429")
        if resp.status_code >= 500:
            raise ProviderError("server", f"HTTP {resp.status_code}")
        if resp.status_code in (401, 403):
            raise ProviderError("auth", f"HTTP {resp.status_code}")
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            msg = ""
            try:
                msg = resp.json().get("error", {}).get("message", "")
            except ValueError:
                pass
            kind = "auth" if "api key" in msg.lower() else "config"
            raise ProviderError(kind, f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {msg[:160]}")
        try:
            parts = resp.json()["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"]
            text = "".join(p.get("text", "") for p in parts if not p.get("thought"))
            return json.loads(text)
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise ProviderError("invalid", "response was not the requested JSON") from exc


# --- service -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass(slots=True)
class ProviderStatus:
    configured: bool
    model: str | None
    last_ok_at: datetime | None = None
    last_error: str | None = None
    last_error_at: datetime | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Brief:
    brief_id: str
    run_id: str
    version: int
    at_tick: int
    clock: str
    provider: str  # gemini | gemini_fallback | template
    model: str | None
    latency_ms: float
    fallback_reason: str | None
    headline: str
    bullets: list[str]
    action: str
    metric_keys: list[str]
    facts: dict[str, str]
    generated_at: datetime
    notice: str = "Synthetic simulation data. Numbers are filled in by TriageX, not the model."
    attempts: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


class BriefService:
    def __init__(self, primary: AIProvider | None, fallback: AIProvider | None,
                 clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC)):  # fmt: skip
        self.primary, self.fallback, self.clock = primary, fallback, clock
        self.status = {
            "primary": ProviderStatus(primary is not None, getattr(primary, "model", None)),
            "fallback": ProviderStatus(fallback is not None, getattr(fallback, "model", None)),
        }
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._latest: dict[str, Brief] = {}

    def latest(self, run_id: str) -> Brief | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._latest.get(run_id)

    def generate(self, state: DashboardState, at_tick: int) -> Brief:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        tick, facts = build_facts(state, at_tick)
        payload = {k: {"value": v.value, "label": v.label} for k, v in facts.items()}
        attempts: list[str] = []
        result = None
        for role, provider in (("primary", self.primary), ("fallback", self.fallback)):
            st = self.status[role]
            if provider is None:
                attempts.append(f"{role}: not configured")
                continue
            for attempt in (1, 2):
                try:
                    raw = provider.generate(SYSTEM, payload, BRIEF_SCHEMA)
                    content, cited = render(raw, facts)
                except (ProviderError, InvalidBrief) as exc:
                    kind = exc.kind if isinstance(exc, ProviderError) else "invalid"
                    if kind == "invalid" and attempt == 1:
                        attempts.append(f"{role} {provider.model}: invalid output, retrying")
                        continue  # invalid structure gets exactly one retry
                    st.last_error, st.last_error_at = kind, self.clock()
                    level = logging.ERROR if kind in MISCONFIGURED else logging.WARNING
                    log.log(level, "brief provider failed",
                            extra={"role": role, "model": provider.model, "kind": kind})  # fmt: skip
                    attempts.append(f"{role} {provider.model}: {kind}")
                    break
                st.last_ok_at, st.last_error = self.clock(), None
                label = "gemini" if role == "primary" else "gemini_fallback"
                result = (label, provider.model, content, cited)
                break
            if result:
                break
        if result is None:
            content, cited = template(facts)
            result = ("template", None, content, cited)
        provider_label, model, content, cited = result
        brief = Brief(
            brief_id=f"brf-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}", run_id=state.run.run_id,
            version=state.run.version, at_tick=tick, clock=facts["clock"].value,
            provider=provider_label, model=model,
            latency_ms=round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1),
            fallback_reason="; ".join(a for a in attempts if "retrying" not in a) or None,
            headline=content["headline"], bullets=content["bullets"], action=content["action"],
            metric_keys=cited, facts={k: v.value for k, v in facts.items()},
            generated_at=self.clock(), attempts=attempts,
        )  # fmt: skip
        with self._lock:
            self._latest[state.run.run_id] = brief
        log.info("brief generated", extra={"provider": brief.provider, "ms": brief.latency_ms})
        return brief

    def health(self, role: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        st = self.status[role]
        name = f"Gemini {st.model}" if st.model else "Gemini"
        if not st.configured:
            return "not_configured", "GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY) is not set"
        if st.last_error in MISCONFIGURED:
            return "error", f"{role} misconfigured ({st.last_error}): {name}"
        if st.last_ok_at is None:
            suffix = f"; last attempt failed ({st.last_error})" if st.last_error else ""
            return "starting", f"{name}: no brief generated yet{suffix}"
        tail = f"; last attempt failed ({st.last_error})" if st.last_error else ""
        return "ok", f"{name}: last brief {st.last_ok_at:%H:%M:%S} UTC{tail}"


def brief_service_from_settings(settings) -> BriefService:
    key = settings.gemini_api_key or settings.google_api_key
    if not key:
        return BriefService(None, None)
    primary = GeminiProvider(key, settings.gemini_model or DEFAULT_PRIMARY_MODEL)
    fallback = GeminiProvider(key, settings.gemini_fallback_model or DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MODEL)
    return BriefService(primary, fallback)

"""Prompt 6: grounded operational brief, Gemini primary -> Gemini fallback -> template."""

    BRIEF_SCHEMA,
    BriefService,
    GeminiProvider,
    ProviderError,
    build_facts,
    render,
)
from app.services.dashboard import build_dashboard
from app.services.demo_service import DemoService

GOOD = {
    "headline": "At {clock}, {focus_hospital} is at {focus_saturation_pct} occupancy.",
    "bullets": ["The two-hour forecast is {focus_forecast_pct}.",
                "{focus_ambulances_waiting} ambulances are waiting to offload."],  # fmt: skip
    "action": "Keep monitoring {focus_hospital}.",
}


class FakeProvider:
    name = "gemini"

    def __init__(self, model, *outputs):
        self.model = model
        self.outputs = list(outputs)
        self.calls = 0

    def generate(self, system, facts, schema):
        self.calls += 1
        out = self.outputs.pop(0) if self.outputs else ProviderError("server", "exhausted")
        if isinstance(out, Exception):
            raise out
        return out


def demo_state(confirm=0, approve=True):
    demo = DemoService()
    run = demo.create_run()
    if approve:
        card = run.recommended_proposal()
        run, req = demo.approve_proposal(run.run_id, card.id, 18)
        for _ in range(confirm):
            demo.simulate_reply(run.run_id, req)
    return build_dashboard(demo, run)


def test_primary_success_renders_numbers_from_the_api():
    state = demo_state()
    primary = FakeProvider("gemini-3.1-flash-lite", GOOD)
    fallback = FakeProvider("gemini-3.5-flash-lite")
    brief = BriefService(primary, fallback).generate(state, 18)
    assert (brief.provider, brief.model, brief.fallback_reason) == (
        "gemini", "gemini-3.1-flash-lite", None)  # fmt: skip
    _, facts = build_facts(state, 18)
    assert brief.headline == (f"At 16:30, Grady is at {facts['focus_saturation_pct'].value} "
                              "occupancy.")  # fmt: skip
    assert brief.metric_keys == ["clock", "focus_hospital", "focus_saturation_pct",
                                 "focus_forecast_pct", "focus_ambulances_waiting"]  # fmt: skip
    assert fallback.calls == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["timeout", "rate_limited", "server", "connection", "auth"])
def test_primary_failure_falls_back_to_gemini_fallback(kind):
    state = demo_state()
    primary = FakeProvider("p", ProviderError(kind))
    service = BriefService(primary, FakeProvider("f", GOOD))
    brief = service.generate(state, 18)
    assert brief.provider == "gemini_fallback" and brief.model == "f"
    assert brief.fallback_reason == f"primary p: {kind}"
    status, detail = service.health("primary")
    if kind == "auth":
        assert status == "error" and "misconfigured" in detail
    else:
        assert status == "starting"


def test_invalid_output_is_retried_once_then_falls_back():
    state = demo_state()
    numeral = dict(GOOD, headline="Grady is at 95% occupancy.")  # a number the model wrote itself
    primary = FakeProvider("p", numeral, numeral)
    brief = BriefService(primary, FakeProvider("f", GOOD)).generate(state, 18)
    assert primary.calls == 2  # one retry
    assert brief.provider == "gemini_fallback"
    assert brief.fallback_reason == "primary p: invalid"
    retried = FakeProvider("p", numeral, GOOD)
    assert BriefService(retried, None).generate(state, 18).provider == "gemini"


def test_both_fail_gives_the_labeled_template():
    state = demo_state(confirm=1)
    brief = BriefService(FakeProvider("p", ProviderError("timeout")),
                         FakeProvider("f", ProviderError("rate_limited"))).generate(state, 18)  # fmt: skip
    assert brief.provider == "template" and brief.model is None
    assert brief.fallback_reason == "primary p: timeout; fallback f: rate_limited"
    assert "1 of 3 staff confirmed" in " ".join(brief.bullets)
    unconfigured = BriefService(None, None).generate(state, 18)
    assert unconfigured.provider == "template"
    assert unconfigured.fallback_reason == "primary: not configured; fallback: not configured"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("raw", "reason"),

        (dict(GOOD, action="Watch {made_up_metric}."), "unknown metric_key 'made_up_metric'"),
        (dict(GOOD, bullets=[]), "bullets must be 1 to 4 non-empty strings"),

def test_spoiler_rule_no_result_before_the_end_of_the_window():
    state = demo_state(confirm=3)

    assert not any(k.startswith(("result_", "amb_hours")) for k in before)

def test_gemini_provider_request_and_error_mapping():

    assert body["generationConfig"]["responseJsonSchema"] == BRIEF_SCHEMA
    assert "temperature" not in body["generationConfig"]

    cases = {

    for status, kind in cases.items():
